title: Full-Time React / Remotion Developer for AI Video Platform
description:
We’re hiring one full-time developer to help turn a working internal AI video tool into a reliable production platform.



The tool takes scripts and voiceovers, generates and selects visuals, then renders complete long-form videos that can be 2–3 hours long. The core rendering layer uses Remotion and React and connects to several external APIs. It already works and is being used in production. We now need to make it faster, more reliable and capable of handling more visual formats.



You will be the main day-to-day builder. A separate senior developer will review architecture and important code, so you will have technical support without being micromanaged.



WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON



- React, TypeScript, Node.js and Remotion development

- Long-running video render jobs, queues, retries and checkpointing

- FFmpeg and other media-processing work

- API and AI-model integrations

- Cloud storage and production deployments

- Fixing bugs and reducing manual work

- Improving render speed, cost and reliability

- Building new production features from clear acceptance criteria

- Tests, documentation and clean GitHub pull requests



WHAT WE NEED



- Strong React, TypeScript and Node.js ability

- Experience with Remotion, FFmpeg or programmatic video generation is a major advantage

- Experience with APIs, asynchronous jobs and production systems

- Evidence that you have personally shipped real software

- Strong debugging skills

- Fast, clear communication and reliable daily availability

- Ability to work independently, raise blockers early and explain trade-offs

- Comfortable using AI coding tools, while still verifying and understanding everything you ship

- Able to commit 40 hours per week long term



PAY AND PROCESS



- $800–$1,000 USD per month to start, depending on ability

- Paid 8-hour practical trial using a small, clearly defined task

- Four-week initial proving period

- Performance and salary review after 60 days

- Long-term role for someone who consistently ships good work quickly



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word REMOTION so I know you read the full post.



Then answer these questions in order:



1. Link 2–3 live products, repositories or relevant projects you personally built. Explain exactly what you did on each.

2. What experience do you have with Remotion, FFmpeg or video/media pipelines?

3. Describe the hardest production bug you personally diagnosed and fixed.

4. Which AI coding tools do you use, and how do you verify the code they produce?

5. What is your exact weekly availability and time zone?

6. What monthly salary are you asking for within the listed range?

7. Confirm whether you can commit 40 hours per week and disclose any other ongoing jobs or clients.

8. In 3–5 sentences: if a three-hour video render fails at 92%, how would you design the system so it does not restart from zero?



Generic applications that do not answer every question will not be considered.

title: NOW HIRING: VIRAL CONTENT CLIPPING & SOCIAL MEDIA DISTRIBUTION SPECIALIST
description:
NOW HIRING: VIRAL CONTENT CLIPPING & SOCIAL MEDIA DISTRIBUTION SPECIALIST



Position: Social Media Virtual Assistant / Viral Content Clipping Specialist

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Long-Term Opportunity

Focus: High-Volume Content Creation, Viral Marketing, Social Media Distribution, AI-Assisted Editing & Performance Analytics



ABOUT US



We are looking for a highly motivated, creative, analytical, and results-driven Social Media Virtual Assistant to help build and operate a network of supporting social media accounts for several established entertainment, music, lifestyle, and hospitality brands based in the United States.



Our brands include:



* Laci Kay Somers – Influencer, entertainer, and lifestyle personality.

* Velvet Cash – Recording artist, music producer, and entertainer.

* Saltmine Studio Oasis – Legendary recording studio, entertainment venue, and creative production facility.

* Diamond Don’s – Restaurant, bar, and live entertainment destination.





We produce a significant amount of professional video and photo content, and we already have extensive libraries of content published online.



We are looking for someone who can take this existing content, creatively repurpose it, and distribute it across multiple social media platforms through a network of supporting fan, entertainment, and community accounts.



Think of this position as operating a high-volume viral content clipping agency dedicated to our brands.



This is not a traditional social media management position. We are looking for someone who understands how to maximize content distribution, experiment with viral marketing strategies, analyze results, and continuously improve performance.



⸻



OUR PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



Our goal is to create a high-volume content distribution system that continuously tests different creative approaches to discover what resonates with audiences.



We believe a single piece of content can be transformed into dozens of different variations by changing:



* The opening hook

* On-screen text

* Video length

* Editing style

* Captions

* Music and sound effects

* Pacing

* Storytelling angle

* Thumbnail

* Target audience

* Platform-specific formatting



We want someone who can consistently experiment with these variables, analyze the results, and identify winning content.



OUR PHILOSOPHY: CREATE. POST. ANALYZE. IMPROVE. REPEAT.



The ultimate goal is to discover high-performing content through our supporting accounts and deliver those winning clips to our team for publication and potential paid advertising on our official brand accounts.



⸻



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CREATE & MANAGE A NETWORK OF SUPPORTING SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNTS



You will be responsible for building and managing a network of secondary social media accounts that support our brands.



These accounts may include:



* TikTok accounts

* Instagram pages

*
 pages

* YouTube channels

* Entertainment-focused pages

* Music discovery pages

* Fan and community pages

* Behind-the-scenes content channels



Your responsibilities will include:



* Creating new supporting social media accounts.

* Developing unique content strategies for different accounts.

* Maintaining consistent posting schedules.

* Optimizing profiles, descriptions, and branding.

* Growing audiences organically.

* Researching relevant communities and engagement opportunities.

* Managing legitimate fan communities and engagement groups.

* Experimenting with different content categories and presentation styles.

* Monitoring account growth and performance.



IMPORTANT: You will NOT have access to or manage our official brand accounts.



Our team will continue managing all official accounts. Your responsibility is to operate supporting accounts that expand our reach and introduce our content to new audiences.



Supporting pages should be clearly identified as fan, community, or promotional accounts where appropriate.



⸻



2. INDEPENDENT CONTENT SOURCING & RESEARCH



One of the most important aspects of this position is the ability to work independently and proactively discover content opportunities.



We will provide two primary sources of content.



SOURCE #1: EXISTING PUBLIC SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT



Our brands already have extensive libraries of videos, photos, interviews, performances, behind-the-scenes footage, and other content published across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
, and other platforms.



We expect you to independently:



* Research and regularly review our existing social media pages.

* Identify older videos and posts with viral potential.

* Download and organize our existing content using appropriate tools and authorized methods.

* Find interesting moments, funny interactions, performances, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage.

* Turn existing posts into fresh short-form videos.

* Discover content opportunities without waiting for instructions.

* Continuously revisit our existing content libraries to identify new creative angles.

* Monitor newly published content from our official pages for repurposing opportunities.



We do not want someone who waits for us to send them videos every day.



We want someone who takes initiative, researches our brands, identifies opportunities, and independently produces content.



SOURCE #2: PRIVATE GOOGLE DRIVE CONTENT LIBRARY



In addition to our publicly available content, we will provide access to a shared Google Drive folder containing additional videos, photos, and other media.



You will be expected to:



* Regularly review the Google Drive content library.

* Identify interesting footage that has not yet been published.

* Find opportunities to create multiple clips from longer videos.

* Combine available footage into engaging short-form content.

* Organize and track which materials have already been used.

* Develop new content ideas based on available footage.

* Maintain an organized archive of source materials and finished clips.



Our goal is to provide access to a large content library while giving you the creative freedom to independently identify and execute opportunities.



⸻



3. HIGH-VOLUME CONTENT CREATION & DISTRIBUTION



Your primary responsibility will be maximizing the amount of quality content distributed across our supporting social media accounts.



Responsibilities include:



* Creating a high volume of short-form video clips.

* Repurposing existing content into multiple variations.

* Publishing content consistently across supporting accounts.

* Editing videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Creating multiple versions of successful clips.

* Repurposing older content into fresh, engaging posts.

* Identifying opportunities to create additional content from existing footage.

* Maintaining an organized publishing schedule.

* Adapting content for different platforms and audiences.



We want someone who can produce a high volume of content without sacrificing creativity or quality.



The objective is to maximize meaningful content experiments and distribution opportunities, not simply upload identical videos repeatedly.



⸻



4. AI-POWERED VIRAL HOOKS & CONTENT EXPERIMENTATION



We strongly encourage the use of ChatGPT and other AI tools to brainstorm creative ways to make our content more engaging.



We are especially interested in attention-grabbing, entertainment-news-style content inspired by platforms such as TMZ.



Examples of creative approaches include:



* Dramatic, curiosity-driven headlines.

* Entertainment news-style text overlays.

* Funny or unexpected observations.

* Debate-provoking questions.

* Behind-the-scenes revelations.

* Celebrity and entertainment-focused hooks.

* Emotional storytelling.

* Unexpected moments and surprising interactions.

* Trending meme formats.

* Viral storytelling techniques.



MULTIPLE VARIATIONS OF THE SAME VIDEO



We want you to regularly experiment with creating 5–10 meaningfully different versions of the same original video when appropriate.



For example, one original video could become:



1. A 10-second attention-grabbing highlight.

2. A 30-second storytelling clip.

3. A dramatic edit with an emotional hook.

4. A funny version with humorous captions.

5. A behind-the-scenes version.

6. A version with curiosity-driven text overlays.

7. A reaction-style video.

8. A version with a completely different opening three seconds.

9. A version with a trending audio format.

10. A different edit targeting another audience.



Each variation should be treated as an opportunity to learn what attracts attention and generates engagement.



EXAMPLE CHATGPT PROMPT



“Analyze this video and generate 20 attention-grabbing, TMZ-style viral headlines that could be used as text overlays for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Make them entertaining, dramatic, curiosity-driven, and designed to stop viewers from scrolling. Keep them short, punchy, and compelling while remaining truthful to the actual footage. Then identify the 10 strongest hooks for testing.”



Your responsibilities will include:



* Finding interesting content from our existing pages or Google Drive.

* Identifying the strongest moments to clip.

* Using ChatGPT to brainstorm multiple viral hooks.

* Creating 5–10 creative variations when appropriate.

* Testing those variations across relevant supporting accounts.

* Tracking which hooks generate the strongest performance.

* Analyzing why certain versions outperform others.

* Creating additional variations based on winning approaches.

* Reporting successful strategies to our team.

* Delivering the strongest-performing clips for potential use on our official brand accounts.



We want you to think like a viral content strategist, not simply a video editor.



⸻



5. VIRAL CONTENT TESTING & EXPERIMENTATION



We want to continuously test different versions of content to determine what performs best.



Each piece of content should be treated as an experiment.



We want to understand:



* Which opening hooks generate the most views?

* Which text overlays capture attention?

* Which video lengths perform best?

* Which editing styles generate the most engagement?

* Which types of content generate the most shares?

* Which captions encourage comments?

* Which platforms perform best for different content categories?

* Which content deserves additional variations?

* Which content consistently underperforms?



We want constant experimentation with new creative ideas and strategies.



The objective is not simply to produce content but to continuously improve our understanding of what makes content successful.



⸻



6. DAILY, WEEKLY & MONTHLY PERFORMANCE REPORTING



THIS IS ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE POSITION.



We expect detailed, organized performance reporting so we can understand what content is working, what is not working, and how to improve.



DAILY REPORTS



At the end of each workday, provide:



* Number of clips created.

* Number of posts published.

* Accounts and platforms used.

* Total views generated.

* Top-performing clips of the day.

* Lowest-performing clips of the day.

* Which hooks, captions, or editing styles performed best.

* Which approaches performed poorly.

* Recommendations for the following day’s content strategy.



WEEKLY REPORTS



Every week, provide:



* Total content created and distributed.

* Total views and engagement across all accounts.

* Top 10 best-performing posts.

* Bottom 10 lowest-performing posts.

* Comparison of performance across platforms.

* Identification of successful content categories.

* Identification of unsuccessful content categories.

* Analysis of winning hooks, captions, video lengths, and editing styles.

* Recommendations for increasing content performance.

* A strategy for the following week based on actual results.



MONTHLY REPORTS



Every month, provide a comprehensive performance summary including:



* Total clips produced.

* Total posts published.

* Total views generated.

* Follower growth across supporting accounts.

* Total engagement.

* Best-performing content of the month.

* Worst-performing content of the month.

* Trends in audience behavior.

* Successful content experiments.

* Unsuccessful content experiments.

* Opportunities for scaling successful strategies.

* Recommendations for improving the overall content distribution system.



CONTENT PERFORMANCE TRACKING



We expect you to maintain an organized spreadsheet or dashboard tracking individual content experiments.



Each published clip should be tracked using metrics such as:



* Original source video

* Brand

* Platform

* Supporting account

* Hook or creative variation

* Posting date

* Views

* Likes

* Comments

* Shares

* Engagement rate

* Performance after 24 hours

* Performance after 72 hours

* Performance after seven days



Content should be categorized as:



WINNER: Strong performance with opportunities for further testing and distribution.



RETEST: Promising content that may perform better with adjustments.



UNDERPERFORMER: Content that consistently fails to generate meaningful engagement.



Performance should be evaluated relative to the account’s typical results, not simply by total views.



We want reporting that provides actionable insights, not simply numbers.



⸻



7. DOUBLE DOWN ON WHAT WORKS



A major part of this role is identifying successful content and expanding on it.



When a particular clip, hook, format, or editing style performs well, we want to:



1. Analyze why it performed well.

2. Identify which elements contributed to its success.

3. Create additional variations using those successful elements.

4. Test those variations across relevant platforms.

5. Compare results and identify improvements.

6. Continue refining the strategy based on performance.



Likewise, when content consistently performs poorly, we want to understand why and adjust our approach.



The goal is to continuously increase our success rate by learning from every piece of content published.



We expect you to use ChatGPT and other tools to brainstorm ways to improve successful content and develop new creative strategies.



⸻



8. IDENTIFY WINNING CONTENT FOR OUR OFFICIAL BRANDS



THIS IS THE ULTIMATE OBJECTIVE OF THE ENTIRE OPERATION.



Our supporting social media accounts will function as a creative testing and content discovery network.



When a particular clip demonstrates exceptional performance, your responsibility will be to:



* Identify the winning content.

* Explain why it performed well.

* Provide performance metrics supporting your recommendation.

* Deliver the finished video to our team.

* Provide the best-performing caption, hook, and title.

* Recommend whether the content should be published on our official accounts.

* Identify clips that may be suitable for paid advertising.

* Suggest additional variations that could be tested.



Our team will continue managing all official brand accounts.



You will NOT have access to our official social media accounts.



Your responsibility is to identify and deliver high-performing content that we can publish and potentially promote through advertising.



⸻



9. SOCIAL MEDIA GROWTH & COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT



In addition to creating and distributing content, you will help grow the supporting social media network.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching relevant communities and audiences.

* Engaging authentically with followers.

* Responding to comments and encouraging discussions.

* Identifying trending topics and content opportunities.

* Researching successful clipping agencies and entertainment accounts.

* Developing strategies to increase organic reach.

* Building legitimate fan communities and engagement groups.

* Identifying opportunities for collaboration with relevant creators.

* Monitoring account growth and audience behavior.



We want creative, sustainable audience growth strategies that comply with platform policies.



⸻



10. CONTENT ORGANIZATION & WORKFLOW MANAGEMENT



You will be responsible for maintaining an organized and efficient content production system.



Responsibilities include:



* Organizing original videos and photos.

* Maintaining folders of edited clips.

* Tracking which clips have already been published.

* Organizing different versions of the same content.

* Maintaining a publishing calendar.

* Tracking performance across accounts.

* Maintaining a library of successful hooks and captions.

* Documenting successful editing styles and content strategies.

* Providing our team with access to finished clips and performance reports.



We want a system that allows us to easily identify successful content and understand what is working.



⸻



IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who:



* Has experience with short-form video editing and social media clipping.

* Understands viral content strategies.

* Is comfortable producing and publishing content at high volume.

* Understands TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Has experience with CapCut, Canva, or similar software.

* Is proficient with ChatGPT and other AI tools.

* Understands social media analytics.

* Can identify patterns in successful content.

* Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Can work independently.

* Is creative, proactive, and constantly experimenting.

* Has excellent written English skills.

* Is motivated by measurable results.

* Can independently source content without waiting for instructions.

* Understands how to write attention-grabbing hooks and captions.



BONUS EXPERIENCE



* Previous work for a clipping agency.

* Experience managing viral fan pages.

* Experience growing TikTok or YouTube Shorts channels.

* Experience with influencer marketing.

* Experience using AI-assisted video editing tools.

* Knowledge of entertainment, music, nightlife, and influencer culture.

* Experience managing multiple supporting social media accounts.

* Experience building performance dashboards and reporting systems.



⸻



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Performance will be evaluated based on:



1. Volume of quality content produced.

2. Consistency of content distribution.

3. Total views and engagement generated.

4. Improvement in content performance over time.

5. Quality and usefulness of daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

6. Ability to identify successful creative strategies.

7. Ability to use AI to improve productivity and creativity.

8. Number of high-performing clips delivered to our official brands.

9. Overall growth of the supporting social media network.

10. Ability to independently identify and execute content opportunities.



We value productivity, creativity, initiative, and measurable results.



⸻



PROACTIVE WORK ETHIC



We value individuals who:



* Take initiative without constant supervision.

* Find their own content opportunities.

* Use AI tools creatively and efficiently.

* Consistently experiment with new approaches.

* Understand how to capture attention within the first few seconds.

* Analyze results and make informed decisions.

* Continuously look for ways to improve performance.

* Can maintain a high volume of meaningful content experiments.

* Are excited about discovering the next viral video.



Our ideal candidate should never be sitting around waiting for content or instructions. There should always be opportunities to discover, create, test, analyze, and improve.



⸻



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous social media management or clipping experience.

3. Examples of short-form videos you have edited.

4. Examples of accounts you have managed or grown.

5. Your experience with ChatGPT and AI-assisted content creation.

6. Your experience tracking and analyzing social media performance.

7. How many short-form clips you can realistically produce per day.

8. Your desired monthly salary in USD.

9. Your availability and preferred working hours.



APPLICATION CHALLENGE



Imagine we provide you with a 60-second video.



Explain how you would:



1. Create 10 different versions using different hooks, captions, and editing styles.

2. Distribute those versions across multiple supporting social media accounts.

3. Track and compare their performance.

4. Identify which versions have the greatest viral potential.

5. Use ChatGPT to develop additional creative variations.

6. Expand on the winning content.

7. Present your findings in a daily performance report.

title: Part-Time Operations Assistant for Dallas Cleaning Business (BookingKoala Setup + Ongoing Ops)
description:

CLRSpace is hiring an Operations Assistant now, before launch, so systems are in place from day one.

> - Test the complete booking and payment workflow end to end

- BookingKoala admin: new bookings, reschedules, cleaner assignments

 - Customer inbox: inquiries, reschedule requests, follow-ups (templates provided, good judgment expected)

- Cleaner recruiting support: messaging candidates and tracking the pipeline in a spreadsheet

- Post-clean follow-ups and review requests to clients

- Keeping SOP checklists updated as the business grows

**Pay:** $600/month for the part-time schedule above, paid weekly for the first two months, then biweekly. 13th-month pay included. Experience with any booking, scheduling, or dispatch system for a service business counts.

- 1+ year in scheduling, dispatch, customer service, or operations support

- Excellent written English (daily written communication with US customers)

- Comfortable with Google Workspace and spreadsheets, fast learner with new software

- Reliable internet with a backup plan for outages

- Available for the Dallas hours above, long term

s: "Your cleaner didn't show up and I have guests coming tonight." Write the reply that would be sent.

title: Senior Product and Graphic Designer
description:
We're looking for a senior designer to own both our product experience and our brand. You'll design the software our customers use every day and the marketing that brings them in. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between UX and graphic design without losing quality.

What you'll do

Product design (about 60%)

• Design screens, user flows and interactions for a web-based SaaS platform, from rough wireframes to dev-ready Figma files.

• Build and maintain a component library and design system the engineering team can build from directly.

• Simplify complex workflows and data dashboards so non-technical users understand them at a glance.

• Design onboarding and setup flows that get new customers live with minimal support.

• Prepare clean handoffs with specs, states and edge cases, and review builds before release.

• Run simple usability tests and turn feedback into design improvements.

Brand and graphic design (about 40%)

• Apply and extend our brand guidelines: logo use, colour, typography, iconography and illustration.

• Design sales collateral, including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies and proposal templates.

• Create marketing assets: social media ads, video thumbnails and ad frames,
 templates and banners.

• Design landing pages and website updates focused on conversion.

• Produce event and trade-show materials when needed.

Requirements

• 5+ years of professional design experience.

• A portfolio showing both shipped SaaS product UI and brand or marketing design.

• Expert in Figma, including auto layout, components and variables.

• Strong in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop (InDesign or Canva a plus).

• Solid grasp of UX principles, accessibility and responsive web design.

• Excellent written and spoken English, including clear async updates.

• Able to work independently, manage your own time and hit deadlines.

• Reliable high-speed internet, backup power and a quiet home workspace.

Nice to have

• Experience designing AI, chat or automation products.

• Background in B2B software.

• Motion graphics or video editing skills (After Effects, Premiere or CapCut).

• Basic HTML/CSS or experience with no-code site builders.

• Experience working with overseas clients or startups.

What we offer

• Stable, long-term remote contract with a fast-growing company.

• Real ownership: your work ships to customers and the market.

• Direct line to the founder and influence over product direction.

• [Paid time off, performance reviews and rate increases].

How to apply



1. A 2–3 minute video introduction (Loom, YouTube unlisted or Google Drive link) covering who you are, your design experience, and why this role suits you.

2. Your portfolio of SaaS work — product UI, dashboards and user flows you've designed, with your role in each project.

3. Any AI SaaS work, if available — AI, chat, voice or automation products you've designed for.

4. Your CV.

Our process: a 30-minute video call, a portfolio walkthrough, a short paid test task, and a final interview.

title: Video Editor & Content Repurposing VA
description:
About Oodleway



Oodleway helps Cavoodle owners raise happy, well-adjusted dogs through practical, breed-specific training and education.



We create educational content, podcast episodes, customer testimonials and video content featuring our founder, Tiana. We're looking for a creative, organised and proactive Video Editor & Content Repurposing VA who can help us get more value from the content we already produce.



You'll work with our existing raw footage, podcast recordings and educational material to create engaging videos, repurpose content across multiple platforms and help prepare everything for publishing.



We're looking for someone who can work independently, identify good content opportunities and take initiative, rather than simply completing tasks we're required to outline in detail.



What You'll Do



1. Short-Form Video Editing



- Turn raw footage into engaging Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts.

- Edit talking-head videos, educational tips, puppy training footage, customer testimonials and behind-the-scenes content.

- Add music, B-roll, text overlays and simple graphics where appropriate.

- Create engaging hooks and maintain a strong pace to keep viewers watching.

- Suggest creative improvements and new content ideas based on the footage provided.



 2. Podcast Editing & Repurposing



- Edit full podcast episodes recorded in Descript, preparing polished episodes ready for publishing.

- Identify and extract interesting, educational or entertaining moments from longer recordings to create multiple short-form video clips.

- Repurpose podcast episodes into YouTube videos, including preparing the finished video for upload.

- Identify strong clip opportunities and suggest timestamps, hooks and titles.

- Help organise podcast files and prepare episodes for publishing through Kajabi.

- Ensure content is polished, consistent and ready for its intended platform.



3. Written Content & Content Repurposing



- Turn podcast episodes and recordings into written blog posts for Kajabi.

- Repurpose podcast discussions into articles suitable for Substack.

- Transform long-form content into shorter pieces for social media and other platforms.

- Draft social media captions to accompany videos and other content.

- Suggest headlines, hooks and titles that capture attention and communicate the value of our content.

- Use AI tools where appropriate to speed up transcription, drafting and content repurposing, while ensuring the final output is accurate, natural and useful.



**Note:** Social media captions will be reviewed and edited by our founder before publishing. You'll be responsible for preparing the initial drafts.



4. Paid Advertising Creatives



- Edit customer testimonial videos into compelling ads.

- Turn raw footage into promotional videos for our Cavoodle Training Academy and other Oodleway products.

- Create variations of successful ads, testing different opening hooks and creative approaches.

- Include appropriate text overlays and clear calls to action.

- Help communicate the value of our products through engaging video content.

- Suggest new advertising angles and creative opportunities based on the footage available.



 5. Content Organisation & Publishing Support



- Organise raw footage, project files, podcast recordings and completed content in Google Drive.

- Prepare final videos in the correct formats for each platform.

- Upload and prepare podcast episodes and associated content through Kajabi.

- Help format and prepare blog posts and articles for publishing on Kajabi and Substack.

- Maintain an organised workflow so content can be reviewed, approved and published efficiently.



 What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing short-form videos for social media and/or paid advertising.

- A portfolio showing examples of Reels, podcast clips, testimonials or video ads you've personally edited.

- Experience editing longer videos or podcasts is highly desirable.

- Strong English comprehension and the ability to draft natural-sounding written content.

- Experience repurposing podcasts, videos or long-form content into articles, blog posts or social media content.

- Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Descript or similar editing software.

- Familiarity with AI tools for video editing, transcription, content creation and repurposing.

- Experience with YouTube, Kajabi and/or Substack is an advantage.

- Strong attention to detail, organisation and time management.

- Someone proactive who can identify good content, make creative decisions and work independently.

- An interest in dogs, pet content or animal training would be a bonus.



We're not looking for someone who simply adds subtitles to videos.We want someone who can recognise good content, make creative decisions and help us turn existing footage and recordings into a range of valuable content with minimal supervision.



How the Role Will Work



We'll provide raw footage, podcast recordings, brand references, examples of content we like and information about our products and audience.



You'll be responsible for editing videos and podcast episodes, identifying content opportunities, drafting written content and preparing assets for publishing.



We'll start with a weekly workload of approximately **6–8 hours**, with the possibility of increasing hours as our content production grows.



This is an ongoing opportunity for someone who produces quality work, communicates well and can become a trusted part of our team.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Links to 3–5 examples of content you've personally edited or created. Ideally, include a short-form video, a video ad or testimonial, and a podcast clip or longer video.

2. Examples of any blog posts, articles or other written content you've created by repurposing existing material, if available.

3. The editing software, AI tools and publishing platforms you use.

4. Your weekly availability.

5. Your estimated turnaround time for a typical 30–60 second Reel.



**Applications without a video editing portfolio will not be considered.**



To confirm you've read the full job description, please start your application with the words **"OODLE CONTENT"**.

description:

Do you excel at creating short-form, high-converting videos for fast-paced digital brands?

Are you highly skilled in using AI tools to improve creative quality, speed, and performance?

If you answered an enthusiastic “YES”, then KEEP READING.



We are Myra Biotech, a fast-growing hair-care e-commerce brand based in Europe. We’re looking for a full-time Video Editor to join and strengthen our existing video editing team.

This is a unique opportunity to play an important role in building and scaling our video department, with the potential to grow into a Head of Video / Creative Lead position as the company expands.

We already have an established internal creative workflow, but we highly value proactive people who bring new ideas, challenge existing processes, and actively contribute to improving our workflows, creative output, and advertising performance.



We need someone to take responsibility for:



Editing UGC and ad creatives for Meta Ads.

Turning raw footage into high-converting video ads with strong hooks, clear storytelling, and fast pacing.

Using AI tools extensively to generate, enhance, and optimize creative assets, visuals, voiceovers, B-roll, and video concepts.

Repurposing content across multiple platforms, markets, and formats.

Collaborating with our marketing and creative teams to test new angles and improve ad performance.

Contributing ideas and feedback to continuously improve our internal creative workflows.

Maintaining brand consistency while experimenting with fresh and engaging styles.

Working quickly and meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality.

Staying constantly updated on new AI technologies, editing tools, creative trends, and developments in the performance-marketing space.



Position Requirements:

Proven experience as a video editor, with a strong portfolio required.

At least 3 years of professional experience as a Video Editor for e-commerce brands, digital brands, or performance-marketing teams. We are looking for someone who understands direct-response creative and already knows what makes an ad perform.

Excellent command of AI tools and a strong ability to integrate artificial intelligence into daily video-production workflows. This is a key requirement for the role.

Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software.

Advanced knowledge of AI-powered creative platforms such as Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, or similar tools.

Strong knowledge of short-form video editing, performance marketing, direct-response advertising, and social-media trends.

A genuine growth mindset and a strong desire to continuously learn, experiment, and stay ahead of new technologies.

Creativity, speed, attention to detail, and a problem-solving mindset.

Proficient in English, which is our main working language. Knowledge of French or Spanish is a plus.

Ability to work within the CET time zone, especially for weekly meetings and team alignment.

Ability to take full ownership of the role and drive results without constant supervision.

A proactive and collaborative attitude, with the confidence to suggest improvements and contribute new ideas.



What we offer:



Full-time, 100% remote position.

Compensation starting from a competitive base salary, with room to grow as you bring value and results to the brand.

The opportunity to join an existing creative team and help build a stronger, more structured, and performance-driven video department.

A clear growth path toward a Head of Video / Creative Lead position.

A fast-moving environment where speed, experimentation, and quality go hand in hand.

The opportunity to work extensively with AI and remain at the forefront of new creative technologies.

A company culture built on Transparency, Speed, Continuous Improvement, Independent Thinking, Responsibility, and Collaboration.



This is your chance to become part of a brand that is scaling quickly in the beauty industry and to play a key role in the continued development of its creative department.

If you are proactive, resourceful, highly experienced in e-commerce video editing, and passionate about AI and emerging technologies, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Administration & Bookkeeping Assistant — Xero, Shopify & Google Sheets
description:
Virtual Administration & Bookkeeping Assistant — Xero, Shopify & Google Sheets



Remote | Supporting Australian business Pope Industries



We are looking for an accurate, organised and dependable virtual assistant to help manage the everyday administration of Cut Length Metals and ALVULT, two different businesses under the one.



Cut Length Metals supplies stainless steel, brass and aluminium cut to size. and ALVULT is a developing aluminium storage product brand.



You will work directly with the owner to keep bookkeeping, stock records, pricing, customer enquiries and general administration organised.



Your responsibilities



Xero bookkeeping for all of Pope Industries



- Enter supplier bills and receipts, with supporting documents.

- Reconcile bank transactions and flag anything unclear.

- Prepare customer invoices and track outstanding payments.

- Keep records ready for review by our accountant or bookkeeper.



Google Sheets and inventory administration for Cut Length Metals



- Maintain our existing main workbook, including pricing, stock levels and stock movements.

- Export sales from Shopify and import them into the workbook.

- Verify that imported sales update correctly across the relevant tabs.

- Check for missing SKUs, duplicate entries, incorrect quantities and formula errors.

- Investigate discrepancies and report anything you cannot resolve.



Shopify pricing for Cut Length Metals



- Identify selling price changes in the main workbook.

- Update the correct Shopify products and variants using our approved pricing rules.

- Match products accurately by SKU.

- Verify that live Shopify prices match the workbook.

- Keep a record of changes. Initially, price changes require approval before going live.



Sales inbox and customer service for Cut Length Metals and ALVULT 



- Monitor and organise sales
s for both businesses.

- Reply to routine enquiries using approved product information and procedures.

- Collect the information needed to prepare accurate quotes.

- Draft quotes and follow up outstanding enquiries.

- Progress to sending standard quotes independently once trained and approved.

- Refer technical questions and unusual requests to the owner.



General administration



- Maintain customer records, files and task lists.

- Support ALVULT enquiry tracking and follow-ups in Go High Level.

- Document recurring tasks so another person can follow the process.

- Provide a brief update on completed work, outstanding tasks and decisions needed.



What we are looking for



- Practical experience with Xero bookkeeping.

- Strong Google Sheets skills, including working with formulas, lookups and multiple connected tabs.

- Experience with Shopify product administration and CSV imports or exports.

- Clear, professional written English.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Confidence checking your own work and investigating discrepancies.

- Willingness to ask questions instead of guessing.

- Reliable internet and availability for some overlap with Queensland business hours.



Go High Level experience and experience supporting an Australian business are helpful, but not essential.



You do not need metal industry knowledge. We will teach you our products and processes.



Hours and working arrangements



The role will start at 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase as the workload grows, and you can take on more tasks 



We will agree on a regular schedule with some overlap during Queensland business hours. During the first month, you will track time by task so we can understand the workload and set realistic priorities.



How to apply



Use this subject line:



ADMIN — Stock, Sheets & Service



Please include:



1. Your résumé and a short introduction.

2. Your experience with Xero, Google Sheets and Shopify. Explain what you personally did in each system.

3. An example of a spreadsheet or bookkeeping error you found and how you resolved it. Do not share confidential client information.

4. Your proposed checks after importing Shopify sales into a workbook that updates stock across several tabs.

5. Your proposed checks before and after updating Shopify prices from a spreadsheet.

6. Your availability, earliest start date and expected hourly rate in USD.



Please also answer this scenario:



A sales import shows 25 units sold, but the stock tab has only reduced by 20 units. What would you check, and what would you report to the owner?



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid practical trial using sample data. This will assess spreadsheet accuracy, Shopify administration and written customer communication.

title: Sales Manager
description:
PLEASE APPLY HERE: https://highgrowth-io.breezy.hr/p/517f2973720901-sales-manager



HighGrowth.io builds outbound sales teams for founder-led, bootstrapped, B2B companies ($500K to $5M ARR) in the US and Europe. We need an additional Sales Team Implementation Manager to help us scale.

 

In this role, you’ll lead and manage client sales team implementations end-to-end, while partnering closely with our founder on strategy, priorities, and continuous improvement of our outbound playbook. 



This is a high-ownership seat: part client delivery, part sales operations oversight, and a key right hand to a strategic executive.



The ideal candidate must be a strong sales leader, but also must be able to work with and alongside other strong personalities. Why? 



Your sales leadership experience will allow you to slot directly into this role, since you already know the general management principles of dialing and sales teams. However, you'll be following the HighGrowth.io playbook and working with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust that playbook to the realities of the specific client.



Additionally, you'll be interacting with the founder (or founders) on the client side. If it's not already clear, bootstrapped founders tend to have very strong personalities.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 • Lead outbound sales implementations for a HighGrowth.io client.

 • Translate our outbound sales playbook into practical hiring, onboarding, metrics, and performance systems for the client.

 • Directly manage offshore dialers and salespeople, maintaining accountability through scorecards and simple performance rhythms.

 • Run performance reviews with the client team, assess progress, and work with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust strategy as needed.

 • Work closely with our founder on non-client-facing founder priorities: process upgrades, internal projects, and playbook refinements.

 • Keep implementation projects organized, including timelines, deliverables, handoffs, and documentation.

 • Coordinate meetings, reporting, and other lightweight activities that keep delivery running smoothly.



We’re Looking For Someone Who Has:

 • Four-plus years of outbound B2B sales management experience, as a leader or coach.

 • Strong operational discipline: you like metrics, routines, and making performance visible.

 • Confidence running multiple workstreams without dropping details.

 • A founder-friendly mindset: proactive, structured, reliable, and comfortable with fast shifts.

 

This is a full-time, remote role. Your work hours will need to overlap with 9am to 4pm US Eastern Time. 

We rely heavily on Apple devices, applications, and services. You should have a post-2021 Mac for this job.

- **CRM & Ticketing:** Maintain customer records, manage support tickets, track issues, and ensure timely resolution.

- **Reporting:** Prepare operational and performance reports, identify issues, and recommend improvements.

Call and

Good written English for short follow-up

title: 3D Rendering + AI Visualization Artist (Hotels and Events)
description:
ABOUT US

YKMD is a fully remote brand agency for boutique hotels, events and service brands across the U.S. and Caribbean. We create realistic, styled images of hotel rooms and event spaces so our clients can sell them before they're built or finished.



OBJECTIVE

We need a 3D Rendering + AI Visualization Artist for project-based work.



You'll build or work from 3D models of rooms and spaces, then use AI image tools to take them to a photorealistic, styled finish. Think lighting, textures, plants, fabrics, decor and atmosphere. The final image should look like a professional photo of a real, finished space.



Clients often want specific furniture, fixtures, art or branded items in their rooms. You'll place those exact objects in the scene, from product photos, links or spec sheets, so they look like they belong there.



Accuracy matters as much as looks. Logos, signage, brand names, objects and room layouts have to match the original exactly. AI loves to scramble text and swap objects. You need to catch it and fix it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build or refine 3D models of hotel rooms, lounges and event spaces

- Render each room type from multiple angles

- Use AI tools to bring renders to a photorealistic, styled finish

- Place specific client-provided objects (furniture, decor, fixtures, signage) accurately and to scale

- Keep layouts, furniture placement and branding true to the original design

- Make sure all logos, signage and text are clean and spelled correctly

- Handle up to 2 rounds of revisions per room

- Deliver high-resolution final files on deadline



WHAT YOU NEED

- Architecture, interior design or 3D visualization background

- Strong skills in SketchUp, 3ds Max, Blender or similar

- Experience with render engines like V-Ray, Enscape, Lumion or Corona

- Hands-on experience with AI image tools (Midjourney, Krea, Magnific, Photoshop Generative Fill or similar)

- Ability to model or source exact objects from product photos or links and place them in a scene to scale, matching color, material and proportions

- Photoshop skills for cleanup and fixing logos and text

- A sharp eye for lighting, materials and styling

- Hospitality or event space work is a big plus

- Reliable with deadlines and good communication



HOW THIS WORKS

This is project-based. A typical project is 3 room types, 4 angles each (12 images), with 2 rounds of revisions per room. You're paid per project. Strong performers get first pick of new projects as they come in.



HOW TO APPLY

Step 1: Complete this form:

1. A short intro about your background and the software you use

3. Which AI tools you use and how they fit into your process

4. Your rate per image or per project, and your usual turnaround time



Start your OnlineJobs.ph application with the words "Render Ready" so we know you read the full post. Applications without the completed form will not be reviewed.

title: Cleaning Company VA: Booking, Dispatch + Customer Calls (US House Cleaning Experience + American-Sounding English)
description:
HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 6 PM US Eastern.



PAY: $800/month to start, $1,000/month after 60 days if it's working. Paid monthly through OnlineJobs.ph Easypay. Long-term, full-time, working directly with the two owners. No middle managers.



⚠️ TWO THINGS ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE. READ THESE FIRST.



1. You've already done this exact job for a US house cleaning company. You've worked as a VA, booker or dispatcher for a US maid service: recurring cleans, deep cleans, move-outs. Window cleaning, pressure washing, janitorial-only or Airbnb turnovers don't count. If you haven't worked for a US house cleaning company, please don't apply. We'll skip it, even if you're great at everything else.



2. You sound like you were born and raised in the United States. This is the one part we can't bend on. Almost everyone who applies speaks great English, so that's not what we're judging. We're listening for one thing: would a customer in Miami who calls us assume they're talking to someone from the US? If there's any accent at all, even a light one, we won't be able to pick you. No hard feelings, and it's nothing against you or your English. This job just needs someone who sounds like a native US speaker: natural American phrasing, and you get how Americans talk (small talk, how people book and complain, holidays, tipping, football season, pop culture). If people often ask whether you grew up in the States, this job is for you.



Spanish is a big plus. A lot of our clients speak Spanish, so if you can take a call in Spanish too, tell us and show us in your voice message.



ABOUT US

We're Mark and Joey, two 19-year-old college students running Vassal Cleaning, a house cleaning company in Miami and South Florida. We book cleans for nice homes and send independent cleaners to do them. Small team, no corporate stuff, and you'd be the voice of the company. We want someone who feels like a friend on the team: chill, funny, and locks in when it counts. If you're super formal and stiff, this probably isn't for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Booking and sales (most of the job)

- Text every new lead back in under a minute, then call them. Leads come from Thumbtack, Google and our website.

- Quote from our price list (standard, deep, move-in/move-out, add-ons like inside the fridge and oven) and close the booking in our CRM.

- Handle "that's more than I expected," and follow up with everyone who didn't book.



Dispatch

- Match each booked clean with a cleaner in that area, and confirm both the day before and the morning of.

- When a cleaner cancels at 7 AM for a 9 AM job, find a replacement fast and tell the client before they notice.



Customer service

- Reschedules, add-ons and complaints. A missed spot means booking a reclean, not arguing.

- Keep every client's notes right: gate codes, parking, pets, what they care about.



MUST HAVE

- 1+ year booking or dispatching for a US house cleaning company. Name the company, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week.

- You've quoted cleans by bedrooms/bathrooms or square feet, and you know a standard from a deep from a move-out clean.

- You sound born and raised in the US, with zero accent (see #2 above). We d
 this from your voice message only.

- At your computer the whole shift, replying in under a minute. Reliable internet plus a backup, a quiet room and a good headset.



BIG PLUS

- Spanish, well enough to take a booking call

- Cleaning software: Booking Koala, ZenMaid, Launch27, Jobber, Housecall Pro, MaidCentral

- Quo/OpenPhone, Thumbtack, Angi, Yelp or Google Local Services

- You know Miami and keep up with US pop culture



WHAT WE OFFER

- Training on our price list, scripts and tools

- A raise to $1,000/month after 60 days, and real room to grow as we grow



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application ourselves. If it reads like ChatGPT wrote it, we skip it. Write like you'd text a friend; typos are fine. Skip a step and we won't read the rest.



1. Subject line: "Vassal VA – [your name] – [the US cleaning company you worked for]"

2. Your house cleaning experience in 3–4 sentences: the company, the city it served, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week, and what software you used.

3. A 60–90 second voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom; make sure the link opens without a login). Talk like it's a real call: a lead asks "How much for a deep clean, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, about 1,800 sq ft?" Give a price (make one up). They say "hmm, that's more than I expected." Show us what you say next. If you speak Spanish, do 20 seconds of it in Spanish at the end.

4. Two quick texts, 1–2 sentences each:

   a. A client texts that the cleaner missed the baseboards and the shower glass. What do you text back?

   b. A cleaner texts at 7 AM that she can't make her 9 AM job. What do you do first?

5. Three quick ones, one line each. No Googling. Wrong answers are fine, we just want your gut answer.

   a. Who is TJR?

   b. A client says "I'm in the 305." What does that mean?

title: Paid Media Manager - Meta & Google Ads
description:
Paid Media Manager (Meta & Google Ads) Remote · Part-time · Independent Contractor



About us

Cocopiña makes feminine clothing for women who love to travel. We are a small US brand and we sell directly to our customers. We shoot all of our own photography and video, so there is a large, organized library to advertise with.



The job

This is a paid advertising role. You run our ad accounts and make them better. You d
 what runs, build and launch the ads, replace what has stopped working, and find what is holding performance back.



The heart of it is reading creative. You look at how individual ads performed and explain what caused the difference — the hook, the format, the angle, the line - and turn that into a recommendation for what we should run and what we should make next.



You will not be producing creative or working with influencers, but we do want creative input from you - angles worth trying, what a hook is missing, what we should shoot next.



Tools and process

We have our tools connected and automated processes set up to pull and analyze account data, including an AI analysis that runs weekly. Part of this job is refining them, and building the systems that keep ad performance improving rather than relying on anyone's memory of what worked.



Each week you report on what you are seeing and set the direction: what should run, what should come off, and what we need to create. You work directly with our creative team, telling them what the account needs and why, so that each round of creative is better than the last. Once it is produced, you build and launch the ads.



Requirements

- Managing Meta ad accounts for fashion or apparel brands at meaningful spend, with real testing experience

- Google Ads experience

- Triple Whale. It is our source of truth for performance across channels, and we work from it rather than from what each platform reports about itself

- You can explain why one ad beat another. "It got a 4x" is not an explanation

- You can write a recommendation specific enough for us to produce from

- You work without discounts, countdowns, or urgency tactics. We do not run them

- Steady judgment at lower order volumes, where a few unusual days are usually noise

- You work independently. We are not going to manage the account over your shoulder, and we need someone who runs it without being chased

- Available Mondays, and reliable with a weekly deadline



Preferred: you have shot, edited, or art-directed ads yourself. People who have made ads read performance differently, and we want that input.



Optional: Pinterest or TikTok advertising, and a working understanding of SEO.



AI

We use AI for analysis, reporting, and internal work. None of our visuals are AI-generated: every image and video is shot by us, and we do not use AI to alter or extend our photography.



To apply

Send us three things:

- Examples of ad accounts you improved - what you found, what you changed, and how you knew it worked

- Ad examples from your own work where one clearly beat the other, and why

- Your rate and your weekly availability

title: Part-Time E-commerce Assistant
description:
Job Title: Part-Time E-commerce Assistant



Platforms: Shopify and TikTok Shop



Job Overview



Chicago Dollz Experience is looking for a proactive, organised, and detail-oriented Part-Time E-commerce Assistant to manage, monitor, and maintain our Shopify store and TikTok Shop.



The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure both platforms remain active, accurate, organised, visually appealing, and up to date. This includes maintaining product listings and inventory, monitoring orders, updating storefront designs, implementing seasonal promotions, and improving the overall shopping experience.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms, a strong eye for design, and the ability to manage daily store operations while keeping the storefront aligned with the Chicago Dollz Experience brand.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail, stays on top of daily tasks, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Shopify Store Management

- Regularly monitor and maintain the Shopify store.

- Keep product listings, descriptions, images, prices, and variants accurate and up to date.

- Update product availability and inventory information.

- Organise collections, categories, product pages, and store information.

- Check for outdated information, missing product details, broken links, and other store issues.

- Ensure the storefront remains functional, professional, and updated.

- Maintain consistency across product information and store presentation.



2. TikTok Shop Management

- Monitor and maintain the TikTok Shop regularly.

- Keep product listings, images, descriptions, pricing, and stock information updated.

- Check product statuses and ensure products are properly listed and available for sale.

- Monitor orders, fulfilment statuses, shipping updates, and customer-related issues.

- Check for product listing violations, warnings, or platform notifications and report issues promptly.

- Update product images, collections, and promotional features where TikTok Shop allows.

- Ensure the shop follows applicable TikTok Shop policies and requirements.



3. Seasonal Storefront Design and Shopping Experience

- Create and maintain an attractive, professional storefront that reflects the Chicago Dollz Experience brand.

- Plan and implement seasonal updates, including homepage banners, promotional graphics, featured products, and collections.

- Maintain a seasonal calendar covering fall, Black Friday, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, summer, and other approved promotions.

- Keep the core store design consistent while refreshing selected visuals and promotions. A complete redesign is not required for every holiday.

- Remove expired promotions and seasonal graphics promptly.

- Organise menus, collections, and product pages so customers can easily find products and complete purchases.

- Check that banners, buttons, menus, and product links lead to the correct destinations.

- Review the store on mobile and desktop to identify confusing layouts, poor-quality images, and shopping obstacles.

- Research established e-commerce stores for inspiration and recommend improvements suited to our brand.

- Update TikTok Shop product images, collections, and promotional features where the platform allows.

- Handle routine design and layout updates within approved guidelines, and flag technical changes that require specialist support.



4. Order and Inventory Monitoring

- Check incoming orders and monitor their status.

- Track stock availability and identify low-stock or out-of-stock products.

- Monitor order fulfilment and shipping updates.

- Identify discrepancies between Shopify and TikTok Shop inventory.

- Escalate delayed orders, inventory issues, and fulfilment concerns when necessary.

- Monitor cancelled orders and investigate discrepancies between Shopify and TikTok Shop records.

- Report order issues that require further investigation or approval.



5. Store Organisation and Maintenance

- Keep both platforms organised and consistent.

- Regularly review product information, pricing, inventory, and store settings.

- Maintain trackers and records of updates, pending tasks, seasonal campaigns, and identified issues.

- Ensure important tasks and promotional updates are completed on schedule.

- Keep product categories, collections, menus, and promotional content organised.

- Identify opportunities to improve store organisation and the customer shopping experience.



6. Monitoring and Reporting

- Conduct regular checks of both platforms during scheduled working hours.

- Monitor store notifications, sales activity, product performance, and operational issues.

- Prepare brief updates on completed tasks, pending items, and issues requiring attention.

- Report technical problems, account warnings, customer concerns, and other urgent matters.

- Proactively flag anything that needs the owner's review or approval.

- Provide recommendations for improving store presentation, product visibility, and operational efficiency.



## Qualifications and Requirements



- Hands-on experience with Shopify and/or TikTok Shop is preferred.

- Hands-on experience updating Shopify themes, homepage sections, navigation, banners, and collections.

- A strong eye for design, product presentation, and an easy-to-use shopping experience.

- Ability to create branded promotional graphics using Canva or a similar design tool.

- Ability to plan and manage seasonal promotional updates and maintain a marketing calendar.

- Ability to share examples of storefronts, seasonal campaigns, or product pages they have worked on.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to monitor multiple platforms and manage tasks consistently.

- Proactive, dependable, and willing to take initiative.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets, trackers, and online tools.

- Able to work independently and provide regular updates.

- Willingness to learn new tools, systems, and e-commerce processes.



Working Expectations



- Part-time position with mutually agreed working hours.

- Complete regular checks of Shopify and TikTok Shop during scheduled hours.

- Keep both stores accurate, organised, active, and up to date.

- Plan seasonal updates ahead of major promotional dates.

- Complete routine store updates and design changes independently within approved brand guidelines.

- Seek approval for major promotional campaigns, significant design changes, pricing changes, and other decisions outside the agreed scope.

- Communicate promptly regarding technical issues or matters requiring additional support.

- Provide a daily or scheduled summary of completed tasks, outstanding items, and store concerns.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Accuracy and consistency of product listings, pricing, and inventory.

- Timeliness of product and storefront updates.

- Consistency of store monitoring and maintenance.

- Timely implementation and removal of seasonal promotions.

- Quality and brand consistency of storefront visuals.

- Accuracy of banners, navigation, buttons, and product links.

- Timely identification and reporting of order or platform issues.

- Organisation of store records, task trackers, and seasonal calendars.

- Responsiveness, reliability, and completion of assigned tasks.



Primary Goal



To ensure that the Shopify store and TikTok Shop for Chicago Dollz Experience remain well-maintained, organised, accurate, visually appealing, and ready to serve customers through consistent monitoring, proactive daily management, and timely seasonal storefront updates.



The successful candidate will help maintain a professional and engaging shopping experience while ensuring that both platforms accurately represent the brand throughout the year.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
We're hiring a Senior Video Editor to help produce Shana Walker’s Reviews — a growing Amazon Influencer brand that creates product review videos to help shoppers make confident buying decisions.

Our content includes Amazon shoppable video reviews, long-form YouTube videos, product demonstrations, side-by-side comparison tests, unboxings, and short-form TikTok content — all designed to educate, engage, and help viewers make informed purchasing decisions.



Please apply with 5 AP if seriously considering position. 



Find us here:

YouTube: 

Amazon Storefront: 

TikTok: 
  



ABOUT SHANA WALKER'S REVIEWS

We produce authentic, helpful, and engaging content showcasing everyday Amazon products. Our goal is to create high-quality videos that demonstrate products in real-world situations, answer shoppers' questions, and help viewers d
 whether a product is right for them.

We're building for the long term, and we're looking for an experienced editor who can take ownership of post-production and help us consistently produce excellent content across multiple platforms. Your editing will play an important role in the quality and growth of our brand.

This is an editing-focused position with flexible hours, starting part-time with the potential to transition to full-time as the business grows.



________________________________________

HOW THIS ROLE WORKS — 30-DAY PAID TRAINING PERIOD

________________________________________



All new hires begin with a paid 30-day training period. This is your opportunity to learn our systems, workflows, and standards — and for us to see how you work. At the end of the 30 days, we'll make a final hiring decision based on your performance, reliability, and fit with the team. Candidates who complete training successfully move into the role.



________________________________________

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our Senior Video Editor, you'll own the post-production process for our Amazon, YouTube, and TikTok content. You'll use your editing expertise and creative judgment to turn raw footage into polished, engaging videos that feel authentic and keep viewers interested.

Your responsibilities will include:

Edit Amazon Influencer shoppable videos, including product reviews, demonstrations, unboxings, installations, and comparisons.

Edit long-form YouTube review and comparison videos from rough footage to final export — cuts, color, audio, motion graphics, and captions

Edit short-form TikTok videos, including talking-head content about the Amazon Influencer Program, using engaging hooks, captions, and pacing.

Build and maintain branded templates, intros/outros, and transition kits

Collaborate directly with Shana and Team on pacing, structure, and creative direction for each video

Work efficiently through 4K footage pipelines without sacrificing quality or turnaround time

Use AI-assisted tools (ChatGPT, Descript, OpusClip, etc.) to accelerate rough cut and repurposing workflows

Review thumbnail concepts and provide editing-informed feedback on click-worthiness

Manage file organization, project archives, and delivery timelines across multiple concurrent videos

Track hours and productivity using Hubstaff (required upon hire)

If applying: Include # of TikTok followers you have



________________________________________

Required:

3+ years editing YouTube or creator content professionally

Expert-level in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro

Fast and efficient with 4K footage — you don't let a heavy timeline slow you down

Strong sense of pacing — you know when a cut is 2 seconds too long

Experience editing product demos, reviews, or comparison formats

Comfortable with AI editing tools (Descript, OpusClip)

Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and mentor junior editors

Excellent written and spoken English

Reliable internet (100 Mbps+ upload and download) and a capable 4K editing workstation

At least 1 hour overlap in MT for check-ins and training (8AM PHT)



Nice to Have:

Experience with Amazon Influencer or affiliate-focused content

Short-form editing experience (Reels, Shorts, TikTok)

Motion graphics skills in After Effects or Fusion

Understanding of YouTube retention analytics and thumbnail strategy

Familiarity with 
 or similar review/delivery platforms

Experience coordinating within a small content team



________________________________________

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who understands that great editing is about more than simply cutting clips together. You should know how to make videos engaging, showcase products effectively, and maintain a natural, trustworthy feel.

Our product reviews should clearly demonstrate how products work and help shoppers understand their features and real-world usefulness. Our YouTube videos should feel polished and hold viewers' attention, while our short-form content should capture interest quickly.

The ideal candidate can take raw footage and creative direction and turn it into excellent finished videos without requiring constant supervision. We value creative judgment, reliability, consistency, and someone who takes pride in their work.

This is an editing-focused role. You will not be responsible for managing or training other editors.



________________________________________

SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

Position: Part-Time Senior Video Editor

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week

Compensation: $450-$600 monthly ($5–$7) USD per hour,  depending on experience and editing ability

Schedule: Flexible working hours, with at least one hour of daily overlap with U.S. Mountain Time. We anticipate coordinating a daily check-in around 6PM Mountain Time, with flexibility as needed. (8AM PHT)



Future Opportunity: Potential to transition to a full-time position as the business grows.

We value flexibility, clear communication, consistent quality, and meeting agreed-upon deadlines. Outside the daily overlap period, you'll have flexibility to organize your work around your schedule.

We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and helping us continually improve and expand our content production.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit the following (ALL REQUIRED):

1. Resume

2. Portfolio — YouTube channel or editing samples (links preferred)

3. Computer specs screenshot (system info clearly visible)

4. Internet speed screenshot: https://www.speedtest.net

5. A short cover message introducing yourself, including:

 • Why you're a great fit for this role 

• Tools and software you're familiar with (e.g., Amazon, Canva, spreadsheets, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, etc.)







Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid test edit using sample footage so we can evaluate editing quality, pacing, communication, and overall fit.

We're excited to find an experienced editor who can help us create consistently excellent content and grow alongside our business.

Role Description

This is a full-time, remote/virtual position for a Virtual Disposition Manager serving our Greater Cincinnati market. The Virtual Disposition Manager will be responsible for managing the remote sale and assignment of properties acquired by the company. 



In this role, you will act as the operational engine behind our property marketing and buyer pipeline. You will be responsible for setting up property listings, executing
 and SMS marketing campaigns, managing media folders, maintaining our buyer database, and coordinating access logistics for property showings. By taking full ownership of dispo administration and marketing workflows, you allow our Lead Disposition Manager to focus on high-level negotiations and closing buyers. 



Key Responsibilities: 



• Property Marketing & Campaign Execution:

        ◦ Prepare and launch property marketing across all channels: website listings, investor portals, social media groups, and local buyer forums.

        ◦ Draft, schedule, and send bulk
 blasts and SMS broadcasts via Resimpli / marketing tools.

        ◦ Organize property photos, videos, and inspection reports into shared Google Drive folders for buyer review.

• Dispositions Operational Support:

        ◦ Support the Lead Disposition Manager with pipeline administration, buyer follow-ups, and document preparation.

       ◦ Draft Assignment of Contract and Joint Venture (JV) agreements via DocuSign/electronic signature tools for team review and issuance.

        ◦ Assist the dispo team by organizing incoming buyer leads, pulling proof of funds (POF), and prioritizing hot buyers for phone outreach.

• Remote Access & Showing Logistics:

       ◦ Coordinate buyer walkthroughs remotely by managing lockbox codes and scheduling access instructions with sellers, tenants, or local inspectors.

       ◦ Keep track of active lockbox inventory, codes, and property access notes.

• Buyer CRM & Database Hygiene:

       ◦ Tag, segment, and update buyer criteria (preferred zip codes, buy boxes, target ROI, cash vs. hard money) in Resimpli/CRM.

      ◦ Scrub and clean the buyer list regularly to remove inactive contacts and maintain high deliverability on marketing campaigns.

• Cross-Department Collaboration:

     ◦ Work closely with our Transaction Coordinator (TC) to verify Earnest Money Deposits (EMD), track assignment agreements, and ensure smooth handoffs to closing.

• Listing & CRM Status Management (System Admin):

      ◦ Listing Status Updates: Update listing statuses in Resimpli promptly as properties move across stages (e.g., Active ➔ Pending ➔ Sold).

     ◦ Deal Pipeline Updates: Maintain accurate deal status progression in Resimpli (e.g., updating statuses upon contract execution, clear-to-close, or inventory transition).

     ◦ Property Site Management: Post, edit, and keep property listings fresh on the buyer website, investor portals, social media groups, and local buyer forums.



Qualifications

Required (Must-Haves):

Real Estate / Virtual Assistant Experience: Previous experience as a Real Estate VA, Admin, or Marketing Assistant.

Exceptional English Communication: Strong written English skills for drafting
 blasts, property listings, and SMS outreach.

High Attention to Detail: Organised and process-driven with the ability to manage CRM status updates and maintain database accuracy.

Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working with Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Docs), web platforms, and communication tools.

Remote Workspace Setup: Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet working environment aligned with US Eastern Time Zone hours

Preferred (Pluses / Nice-to-Haves):

CRM Experience: Prior hands-on experience using Resimpli, Salesforce, or similar real estate CRMs.

Wholesale Dispositions Background: Experience with wholesale real estate marketing, buyer database management, or issuing Assignment Contracts.

E-Signature & Blast Tools: Familiarity with DocuSign and bulk
/SMS broadcast software.

, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and spreadsheets.
