title: Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Company: Zean Health – Home-Based Primary Care

Location: Remote 

Position Type: Part time to transition to Full-Time

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including a one-hour break

Experience Level: Experienced Medical Virtual Assistant (Healthcare Experience Required)



About Zean Health



Zean Health is a growing, physician-led home-based primary care practice serving patients in assisted living facilities, senior living communities, nursing facilities, and private residences in the United States.



Our mission is to provide accessible, compassionate, coordinated medical care to patients where they live.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and compassionate Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Care Coordinator to help manage daily administrative operations and coordinate communication between our medical providers, patients, families, and healthcare facilities.



This is not simply a scheduling or receptionist position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of administrative workflows, independently follow through on tasks, anticipate problems, and ensure that patient care requests are handled promptly and efficiently.



Key Responsibilities



1. Patient Care and Facility Coordination



Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for assisted living facilities, nursing homes, patients, and healthcare partners.



Receive incoming calls, messages, and requests from multiple healthcare facilities.



Accurately document requests for medication orders, laboratory testing, imaging, referrals, and other patient care needs.



Promptly communicate requests to the physician or appropriate clinical team member for review and authorization.



Track all requests from receipt through completion, ensuring that no orders or important communications are missed.



Follow up with facilities, pharmacies, laboratories, and other healthcare partners to confirm that authorized orders have been received and processed.



Escalate urgent clinical requests promptly according to established protocols.



Maintain professional, courteous, and timely communication with facility staff.



2. Phone Management and Patient Scheduling



Staff and manage the practice's phone line during assigned U.S. business hours.



Answer incoming calls professionally with excellent spoken English.



Schedule and coordinate patient appointments, including new admissions, post-hospital discharge visits, routine follow-ups, and urgent appointment requests.



Coordinate physician schedules across multiple assisted living and residential locations.



Confirm appointments and communicate scheduling updates to facilities and patients.



Maintain accurate scheduling records and assist with optimizing physician visit routes.



3. Insurance Verification and Patient Intake



Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits before scheduled appointments.



Confirm Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance information as applicable.



Identify insurance discrepancies and communicate potential coverage issues before visits.



Complete and organize patient registration and check-in documentation.



Obtain and track required intake forms, consents, demographic information, and relevant medical records.



Ensure patient charts are prepared and administrative documentation is complete before provider visits.



4. Electronic Health Record (EHR) Management



Monitor the EHR task inbox and incoming communications throughout the workday.



Perform a minimum of two structured EHR task and order sweeps daily to identify outstanding requests, incomplete tasks, and pending orders.



Track and follow up on outstanding orders until their status is resolved.



Upload, label, and attach incoming faxes and documents to the correct patient charts.



Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date patient records.



Flag incomplete documentation, outstanding referrals, and administrative issues requiring physician attention.



Ensure all patient information is handled confidentially in accordance with HIPAA requirements.



5. Fax and Referral Management



Monitor and clear the electronic fax inbox daily.



Download, categorize, and appropriately file incoming referrals, medical records, laboratory reports, and facility communications.



Respond to requests for medical records and administrative documentation within authorized workflows.



Track outgoing referrals and follow up on outstanding referral requests.



Ensure important documents reach the appropriate provider promptly.



6. Administrative Operations and Process Improvement



Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for front-desk operations, facility communication, scheduling, order tracking, and administrative workflows.



Help create training materials, checklists, and process documentation.



Maintain organized task lists and follow-up trackers.



Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements.



Assist with additional administrative duties as needed.



Support occasional marketing, referral outreach, and practice growth activities.



Required Qualifications



Previous experience working as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Administrative Assistant, Patient Care Coordinator, or similar healthcare support role.



Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication skills.



Experience handling incoming medical office calls and coordinating patient-related requests.



Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.



Ability to independently manage multiple tasks, prioritize deadlines, and follow through without constant supervision.



Familiarity with electronic health records, medical terminology, and healthcare administrative workflows.



Experience with U.S. medical insurance verification and patient scheduling.



Comfortable working U.S. business hours, including overnight or graveyard shifts in the Philippines.



Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, and appropriate equipment for remote work.



Professional, patient, compassionate, dependable, and solution-oriented.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting a U.S.-based primary care or home-based medical practice.



Previous experience coordinating with assisted living facilities, nursing homes, home health agencies, or post-acute care providers.



Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.



Experience managing physician orders, referrals, faxes, and EHR task queues.



Experience with DrChrono, or similar EHR systems.



Previous experience working overnight shifts supporting U.S. healthcare organizations.



Experience creating SOPs and improving medical office workflows.



What We Value



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.



Understands the importance of timely communication in patient care.



Is meticulous about following up on orders and unresolved requests.



Can manage competing priorities while remaining calm and professional.



Communicates respectfully with elderly patients, families, facility staff, and physicians.



Takes accountability for assigned tasks and provides clear updates.



Wants to grow with a developing medical practice.



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit an application addressing all seven points below:



Professional Background: Briefly introduce yourself and describe your medical administrative or virtual assistant experience.



Healthcare Experience: Describe your experience working with U.S. medical practices, including any exposure to assisted living facilities, nursing homes, home-based primary care, or physician house-call services.



Insurance and EHR Experience: Explain your experience with insurance eligibility verification, Medicare or Medicaid, patient scheduling, and electronic health records. List the EHR systems you have used.



Care Coordination Experience: Describe how you have managed incoming patient requests, physician orders, referrals, and follow-ups. Include an example of how you ensured an important task was completed.



Graveyard Shift Experience: Describe your previous experience working overnight shifts, including how long you have worked U.S. business hours and your ability to maintain this schedule consistently.



English Video Introduction (Mandatory): Submit a 1–2 minute video of yourself speaking English. Introduce yourself, summarize your healthcare experience, and explain why you would be a good fit for this position. Applications without a video introduction will not be considered.



Availability and Compensation: State your earliest available start date, desired hourly or monthly compensation in USD, internet reliability, and whether you are seeking long-term full-time employment.



Important: Please begin your application with the words "Zean Care Coordinator" so we know you have carefully read the job description.



Join Our Team



At Zean Health, we believe that excellent patient care depends on excellent coordination behind the scenes.



We are looking for a dependable, compassionate professional who takes pride in keeping operations organized, supporting physicians, and helping patients receive timely care.



If you are experienced, proactive, and committed to providing outstanding administrative support, we would love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant#2
description:
Virtual Assistant — Adjusted Wellness (Chiropractic & Functional Medicine)

About us-

First: Our doctor got overwhelmed by the number of responses to the first ad he posted, so if you read this ad closely, he's added a few things to it that you must include to be considered for the job. He does this to help you, he wants to work closely with someone that he's going to build trust with. 

Adjusted Wellness is a growing chiropractic and functional medicine practice bringing on roughly 15 new patients a month, with a functional medicine diagnostics line (full blood panel, gut barrier testing) alongside standard care. We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant whose entire job is taking as much as possible off the doctor's plate — this role lives or dies on that, more than any single task on the list below.



What you'll be doing



-Manage the practice's calendar in Jane App — booking, rescheduling, and confirming appointments for new and existing patients

-Follow up by text/email and potentially calling with patients who paid a deposit prior to their Report of Findings but haven't yet committed to their full care plan — track every one until they convert or clearly decline using the office's software.

*In the subject line to your response, include the word "PINEAPPLE" (in all caps) and a color. If you don't, that's 1 way you won't be considered.

-Send appointment reminders and reduce no-shows with a standard confirmation sequence (call/text 48 hrs and 24 hrs out)

-Handle inbound patient
s and texts — answer routine questions, route anything clinical to the doctor

-Data entry: new patient intake forms, payment info, superbills (we don't bill insurance directly — only issue superbills on request), and updates into Jane App

-Help the doctor and staff track supplement inventory (Microbiome Labs, Apex Energetics, Designs for Health) when stock runs low

-Coordinate monthly tabling events at partner gyms (Gold's Gym, Crunch Fitness) — confirm the date/time with the gym contact, prep sign-up sheets, follow up with leads collected

-Maintain a simple weekly report of patients booked, deposits collected, and follow-ups completed for the doctor's Friday review

-Must-have skills



Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable learning new software quickly (Jane App experience a plus, not required)

Reliable internet (minimum 10 Mbps) and a quiet workspace

Strong follow-through — proactive about finding more to take off the doctor's plate, not just completing the assigned list

*go to the doctor's website "
"- hover over the "who we are" section at the top- put in the beginning of your response the 2 techniques the doctor lists there in that dropdown.



Nice to have



Prior experience in a medical, chiropractic, or wellness practice

Experience with patient scheduling software (Jane App, similar)

Basic spreadsheet comfort (Google Sheets / google docs)

Hours & schedule Monday–Friday, part-time to start (10-20 hrs/week), US Eastern Time business hours. Potential to grow to full-time as responsibilities expand.



Pay $4–7/hour depending on experience, paid biweekly. Starting estimate hours: roughly 10-20 hrs/week.



How to apply

Send a short video of your smiling face telling us: (1) your experience with patient scheduling or admin work, (2) a time you caught a mistake before it became a problem, (3) your available hours (the office is open Monday thru Thursday 8:30am-6pm EST). We read every application closely, so in the subject line, work in the word PINEAPPLE — it tells us you read this whole posting before applying, which matters a lot for this role. It's highly recommended that you start off your video with: "Hey Dr. Elmore!" (yes there were more things above to include in the message. The better you follow ALL the directions, the more likely it is that you end up landing an interview.



Note: Applications for this job will be open until THIS Friday at 9pm EST.

title: Cloud Engineer (Azure / API Management)
description:
Cloud Engineer (Azure / API Management)

Location: Cebu or Manila, Philippines (Remote-first, aligned to Australian business hours – AEST)

Employment Type: Fixed-term engagement | Potential casual/project work after initial uplift



The Role  

C9 is looking for an Azure API Management (APIM) Developer who will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and maintaining secure and scalable API solutions using Microsoft Azure API Management. You will work within an Agile team to implement API gateways, policies, integrations, security controls, and monitoring solutions, ensuring reliable API delivery that meets client requirements and follows established technical standards. 

There may be occasional involvement in client projects where your expertise is required, but the core purpose of this fixed-term role is to uplift C9's internal delivery capability. After the initial fixed-term engagement, there may be an opportunity to continue with C9 on a casual, contract or project-by-project basis as needs arise.



Responsibilities:

Design, configure, publish, and maintain APIs using Azure API Management.

Develop and manage APIM policies for authentication, authorization, transformation, routing, throttling, caching, and error handling.

Implement secure API access using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API keys, certificates, and Azure security services.

Configure API products, subscriptions, revisions, versions, named values, and related APIM components.

Integrate APIs with backend services, Azure services, applications, and third-party systems.

Monitor API performance, availability, errors, and usage, and troubleshoot issues affecting service reliability.

Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes for APIM configurations using Azure DevOps.

Maintain API specifications, technical documentation, configuration standards, and deployment procedures.

Collaborate with developers, architects, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver API solutions.

Identify opportunities to improve API performance, security, maintainability, and operational efficiency.



What We're Looking For

4+ years of experience working with Microsoft Azure and Azure API Management (APIM).

Strong practical understanding of:

Azure API Management

API gateways and API lifecycle management

APIM policies and policy expressions

RESTful APIs and API integration

API authentication and security

Hands-on experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API keys, certificates, and related security mechanisms.

Experience integrating APIs with Azure services, backend applications, and third-party systems.

Experience troubleshooting and supporting APIs in production environments.

Understanding of cloud-based architecture and Azure best practices.



Project & Delivery Skills

Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, Jira (or equivalent), and modern development workflows.

Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.

Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams while remaining accountable for outcomes.

Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving capability.

Proactive, self-directed, and delivery-focused.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Mozaik Joinery & Cabinet Drafter
description:
Note: Work Arrangement: 100% Remote – Work from Home



ABOUT COAST BAY KITCHENS & CABINETS

Coast Bay Kitchens & Cabinets (CBK) is a premium Sydney-based joinery and cabinet-making company delivering bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, laundries, and custom joinery solutions across residential and commercial projects throughout New South Wales.

Backed by in-house CNC production, a skilled on-floor team, and a commitment to design excellence, CBK is growing rapidly and building a remote production-support function to scale its drafting pipeline without compromising quality or turnaround time. 



THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Mozaik Drafter to join our team remotely from the Philippines. You will work directly from client-supplied plans and specifications — interpreting architectural drawings, builder layouts, and client briefs — and produce accurate, CNC-ready cabinet and joinery drawings using Mozaik software.

This is an excellent long-term opportunity for someone who is passionate about cabinetry design, takes pride in precision, and wants to grow with a quality-focused Australian company.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Drafting & Design

Project Coordination

, cloud folders, and scheduled video calls

● Meet project deadlines and communicate clearly if timelines are at risk



Quality & Standards

● Ensure all drawings conform to CBK templates, naming conventions, and file organisation standards

● Perform thorough self-checks before submitting drawings — dimensions, clearances, hardware placements, and material codes

● Incorporate feedback from revisions promptly and accurately

Quoting Support (as required)

 (Gmail or Outlook)            Day-to-day project communication          Required

ABOUT YOU — ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

To be considered for this role, you must meet ALL of the following:

● Proficiency in Mozaik cabinetry software — this is a hard requirement; applications without demonstrated Mozaik experience will not be progressed

● Minimum 2–5 years of experience in joinery or cabinet drafting in a production environment

● Solid understanding of cabinet construction methods — carcass, face frame, hinge placements, drawer configurations, shelving, and hardware

ADVANTAGEOUS (NOT ESSENTIAL)

WHAT WE OFFER

● Stable, long-term remote contract with a growing Sydney joinery company

● Direct working relationship with the company Director — no bureaucracy, quick decisions

● Regular, predictable project workflow — no feast-or-famine freelance cycles

● Mozaik software licence provided and supported by CBK

● Opportunity to expand your role and responsibilities as the company grows

● Collaborative, respectful team culture — quality is valued over speed



SELECTION PROCESS

Step Stage Details

1 Application Review CV, portfolio, and covering
 assessed — Mozaik experience screened

Coast Bay Kitchens & Cabinets Pty Ltd |  Sydney, NSW, Australia |

Working Arrangements



We offer flexible working hours. You can choose when to complete your editing work, provided deadlines and communication expectations are met.



However, you must be available to:

* Provide regular progress updates on assigned projects.

Compensation & Contract

* Contract: Monthly, renewable based on project availability and performance.

We Are a Performance-Driven Team

While the starting compensation is $200 USD/month, we’re open to reviewing and negotiating rates once we’ve had the opportunity to assess your output, reliability, and overall performance.

How to Apply



Please complete our application form:

Arc Visuals Team

This person will help keep projects organized, conduct initial vendor and venue research, maintain project documentation, support proposals, track outstanding items, and make sure important administrative details do not fall through the cracks.

About You



You take pride in making sure the department is organized and operations flow seamlessly. Your zone of genius is bringing order to complexity and finding ways to make processes more efficient. You naturally notice when something could be organized better, simplified, documented, or improved.



We work in a fast-paced event agency environment where multiple projects are moving at the same time, deadlines are real, and priorities can shift quickly. You will need to be comfortable managing several requests at once while staying organized, calm, responsive, and detail-oriented.



You do not just complete tasks. You think about how the work gets done. If you see the team repeating the same manual process over and over, you look for a better way. If information is difficult to find, you organize it. If a process is unclear, you help document it. If something is falling through the cracks, you create a system to prevent it from happening again.



You genuinely enjoy being the person behind the scenes who helps the entire department operate better.



You understand events and thrive in a fast-paced environment where multiple projects are moving at once, deadlines are tight, and priorities can change quickly. You know how to shift gears while staying organized, calm, and focused on the details that matter.



You are also a strong researcher. If an Account Manager asks you to research five venues, you understand that sending five website links is not enough. You gather the information needed to make a decision, including availability, capacity, location, pricing, restrictions, included services, and other important event considerations.



You are proactive about follow-through. When you are waiting on a quote, COI, W-9, contract, or answer from a vendor, you follow up without needing to be reminded.



You understand that small details can become large event problems. You take pride in being someone the team can trust to keep information organized, accurate, and moving forward.



Most importantly, you enjoy helping others work more efficiently. When you are doing your job well, Account Managers have more time to focus on their clients, solve problems, think strategically, and grow their accounts.



What You Will Own



Accounts Department Administration

Help keep the Accounts Department organized and operating consistently across projects.

• Create new project folders in Dropbox using established folder structures.

• Manage and maintain account and project folders in Dropbox, ensuring files are organized, current, and easy for the team to access.

• Archive, remove, and maintain project folders as needed.

• Maintain organized project documentation and file naming.

• Support contract administration and document organization.

• Maintain and update the agency's vendor database and vendor lists.

• Organize and maintain department SOPs, templates, and process documents.

• Help ensure teams are using the most current versions of templates and documents.

• Serve as the administrative owner of assigned department perks, policies, trackers, or recurring processes.

• Identify missing information or outstanding administrative items and follow up without waiting to be asked.

• Support new client, project, and vendor onboarding processes.

• Coordinate and track Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and other required event documentation.

• Maintain project trackers, timelines, contact lists, and administrative records.

• Assist with data entry, document preparation, scheduling, and other administrative needs.

• Help ensure project information is accurately documented and communicated internally



Goal: Create consistent administrative systems so Account Managers do not have to spend their time maintaining them.



Vendor Research & Event Logistics Support



Take the first pass at research and coordination work that can consume significant Account Manager time.

• Research venues and vendors based on project requirements.

• Research restaurants, transportation, gifting, entertainment, staffing, rentals, and other event needs.

• Research venues, caterers, rental companies, entertainment, production partners, promotional vendors, and other event resources.

• Request and organize vendor quotes, pricing, availability, and capabilities.

• Follow up with vendors and partners to obtain outstanding information and documentation.

• Gather quotes and supporting information.

• Build organized vendor and venue comparison sheets.

• Assist with vendor onboarding.

• Collect and organize Certificates of Insurance (COIs), W-9s, contracts, menus, specifications, and other required documents.

• Track vendor confirmations, deadlines, and deliverables.

• Follow up on missing vendor information and documentation.

• Assist with shipping, receiving, and inventory tracking.

• Maintain organized vendor information for future agency use.

• Flag incomplete information, missed deadlines, pricing changes, or other potential issues to the appropriate Account Manager.

• Create vendor comparison documents and research summaries.

• Assist with tracking event logistics, including shipping, deliveries, rentals, load-in/load-out, staffing, and vendor requirements.



Goal: Account Managers should be reviewing options and making decisions rather than spending hours gathering basic information.



Project & Administrative Coordination



Keep every assigned project organized and moving.

• Update project timelines, task lists, and trackers.

• Track deadlines and outstanding items.

• Follow up with internal team members and vendors on assigned deliverables.

• Schedule internal, client, and vendor meetings.

• Assist with meeting preparation, notes, recaps, and follow-up items.

• Take clear meeting notes and document next steps.

• Assign and track action items based on meeting direction.

• Organize project folders, decks, contracts, budgets, and event documents.

• Maintain project contact lists.

• Maintain event and project calendars.

• Assist with guest lists, registration information, and attendee data when needed.

• Help prepare event documents such as production schedules, staffing information, and run-of-show documents.

• Proactively identify missing information or upcoming deadlines and follow up as needed.

• Support Account Managers with day-to-day project coordination.

• Help maintain project information and updates within company systems.



Goal: Nothing falls through the cracks.



Proposal & Deck Support



Support the Accounts and Sales teams with the research and administrative work required to develop strong proposals.

• Review notes from sales and discovery calls.

• Pull key information from call notes and organize it into an initial proposal framework.

• Draft initial proposal documents for Account Manager review.

• Research vendors, venues, products, and event elements required for proposals.

• Request preliminary quotes and pricing.

• Prepare venue selection decks.

• Prepare initial event scope documents.

• Build vendor and venue comparison documents.

• Organize photos, specifications, pricing, and supporting materials.

• Update existing proposal templates.

• Organize and maintain proposal templates in Canva, Dropbox, and other agency systems.

• Check proposals for missing information, inconsistent formatting, outdated information, or incomplete sections before Account Manager review.



The Event Administrator prepares the first pass. The Account Manager remains responsible for strategy, recommendations, final pricing, client communication, and final approval.



Goal: Give Account Managers a strong starting point instead of requiring them to build every proposal and research document from scratch.



Contract & Documentation Support

• Organize client and vendor contracts.

• Track contract status and outstanding signatures.

• Maintain current versions of contracts and related documents.

• Collect required vendor documentation.

• Maintain COI records and follow up on missing or incorrect certificates.

• Collect and organize W-9s.

• Maintain menus, venue specifications, vendor specifications, and other project documents.

• Flag missing documentation before project deadlines.

• Support project closeout and document archiving.



Shipping & Inventory Support

• Create and maintain shipping trackers.

• Track shipments and delivery status.

• Maintain inventory lists for assigned projects.

• Confirm delivery addresses and receiving instructions.

• Organize tracking numbers and shipping documentation.

• Follow up on delayed or missing shipments.

• Flag shipping issues immediately to the appropriate project owner.



What This Role Does NOT Own



To keep responsibilities clear, the Event Administrator supports the work but does not replace the Account Manager or Event Manager.

• Client relationship management.

• Event strategy and creative direction.

• Final vendor selection.

• Negotiating significant vendor terms.

• Final event budgets and financial decisions.

• Client recommendations.

• Scope changes.

• Major production decisions.

• Managing client expectations.

• Overall event execution and results.

• Growing and retaining client accounts.

The Event Administrator's job is to gather, organize, track, prepare, and follow through so the project owner can make better and faster decisions.



What Success Looks Like

• Account Managers spend less time on repetitive administrative work.

• Project folders and documentation are consistently organized.

• Vendor research arrives organized and ready for review.

• Quotes and preliminary information are collected on time.

• COIs, W-9s, contracts, and vendor documents are complete and easy to locate.

• Project trackers accurately reflect current status.

• Follow-ups happen without Account Managers repeatedly asking.

• Proposal first drafts are organized and reduce preparation time.

• Vendor and venue comparison sheets make decisions easier.

• Deadlines and outstanding items are consistently tracked.

• Potential problems are flagged early.

• Account Managers trust that when something is assigned to you, it will be followed through to completion.



Qualifications



• 2+ years of professional event, experiential marketing, event production, hospitality, or event coordination experience required; 3 to 4 years strongly preferred.

• Prior experience supporting the planning and execution of live events.

• Working knowledge of the event planning process, including venues, vendors, timelines, budgets, contracts, logistics, and onsite execution.

• Thrives in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple projects moving at the same time.

• Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Strong online research skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable managing multiple assignments and deadlines.

• Comfortable following established SOPs and processes.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.

• Experience with Dropbox preferred.

• Experience with Canva preferred.

• Comfortable learning project management, event, and agency technology platforms.

• Experience researching vendors, venues, restaurants, travel, or events is a plus.

• Experience with event proposals, vendor documents, COIs, W-9s, or contracts is a plus.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying highly communicative.



Our Core Values



WOW SERVICE: We are committed to great operations. Being accountable, a trusted advisor, and results oriented.

PROACTIVE: We are proactive to take the initiative to go above and beyond our job responsibilities. We are self-motivated and seek opportunities to make a positive impact.

FUN + ENGAGEMENT: We create a positive work environment that fosters associate and client satisfaction, engagement, creativity and productivity.

GROWTH: For IMG to grow, we must each learn and grow. We are humble and open to new ideas as our world is constantly growing.

INNOVATION: We are committed to a culture of innovation, forward thinking and adaptability, which can contribute to long-term success and growth.

COMMUNITY: We give our time and resources to support each other and our communities.

title: Event Designer
description:
About Innovate Marketing Group



Innovate Marketing Group is an experiential marketing and events agency creating meaningful brand experiences that bring people together. From corporate events and conferences to experiential activations, VIP experiences, and multi-city programs, our team manages the details that turn ideas into memorable experiences.



We believe great events come from great people, thoughtful planning, strong communication, and an obsession with delivering WOW service.

 

The Role



Innovate Marketing Group is seeking a creative, detail-oriented Event Designer to translate event concepts, client objectives, and brand identities into compelling visual experiences. 



This position will work closely with our account management and production teams to develop creative concepts, event layouts, visual presentations, branded environments, activations, stages, booths, signage, and other experiential elements. 



We are looking for someone who can balance creativity with real-world event execution. The ideal candidate understands that event design is not only about creating beautiful visuals - it also requires consideration of venue dimensions, budgets, materials, production capabilities, guest flow, brand guidelines, and client feedback. 



About You



You are a creative thinker who loves bringing ideas to life through thoughtful, visually compelling event design. You understand that great event design is not just about making something look beautiful—it is about creating an experience that supports the client’s goals, tells a story, and leaves a lasting impression on guests.



You thrive in a fast-paced event agency environment where multiple projects are moving at the same time, deadlines are tight, and creative direction can evolve quickly. You are comfortable shifting between projects, incorporating feedback, making revisions, and working within real-world timelines and budgets without losing sight of the creative vision.



You have a strong eye for design, scale, proportion, color, materials, branding, and spatial flow. When you receive a creative brief, you do not simply make something visually appealing. You think about how guests will enter the space, what they will see first, how they will move through the experience, where key brand moments should happen, and how every element works together.



You understand that event design also needs to be buildable and functional. A beautiful rendering is only successful if it can actually be produced. You consider venue restrictions, dimensions, fabrication methods, materials, installation requirements, guest capacity, accessibility, sightlines, traffic flow, and budget when developing your designs.



You are resourceful and solutions-oriented. If the initial creative direction is outside the budget, you do not simply remove elements—you think creatively about how to achieve a similar look and impact through different materials, finishes, rentals, layouts, or fabrication methods.



You are also a strong researcher. You look for inspiration, emerging event and design trends, materials, furniture, décor, fabrication techniques, experiential activations, and new ways brands are engaging their audiences. You know how to take inspiration and turn it into something original and appropriate for the client rather than simply recreating what has already been done.



You pay close attention to brand guidelines and understand how to translate a brand into a physical environment. You can take a client’s colors, typography, messaging, personality, and campaign creative and thoughtfully extend them across signage, stages, activations, décor, environmental graphics, and other event touchpoints while maintaining brand consistency.



You welcome feedback and understand that revisions are a normal part of the creative process. You do not become overly attached to one idea. You listen carefully to feedback from clients, Account Managers, vendors, and leadership, ask questions when something is unclear, and use that feedback to strengthen the design.



You are detail-oriented and take ownership of your work. Before submitting a deck, rendering, floor plan, or design file, you review it carefully for spelling, alignment, dimensions, branding, consistency, and overall presentation. You understand that even small mistakes can impact client confidence or create larger production issues later.



You are proactive about communication and follow-through. If you are missing dimensions, brand assets, venue information, or other details needed to complete your work, you ask for them early rather than waiting until the deadline. If you identify a potential production challenge, you flag it and help find a solution.



Most importantly, you genuinely enjoy transforming ideas into experiences. When you are doing your job well, the team can confidently present creative concepts that excite clients, differentiate IMG, can realistically be produced, and ultimately create memorable experiences for the people attending them.



Key Responsibilities 



Event Concept & Creative Development 

• Develop creative concepts and visual directions for corporate events, experiential activations, conferences, pop-ups, exhibits, and branded experiences. 

• Translate client briefs, objectives, and brand guidelines into cohesive event environments. 

• Create mood boards, inspiration boards, color palettes, and overall design directions. 

• Brainstorm creative event elements, installations, photo moments, stages, signage, displays, and guest experiences. 



Event Renderings & Layouts 



• Develop event renderings, floor plans, layouts, elevations, and visual mockups. 

• Create realistic representations of event spaces to help clients visualize proposed concepts. 

• Design stages, booths, registration areas, lounges, product displays, branded environments, and other event elements. 

• Revise designs efficiently based on client and internal team feedback. 



Presentation & Proposal Support 



• Create polished visual materials for client presentations, proposals, pitches, and RFP responses. 

• Work with the account team to ensure creative concepts align with the project's objectives, budget, venue, and production requirements. 

• Help communicate design concepts clearly through presentations and supporting visuals. 

Production Collaboration 

• Prepare artwork, specifications, dimensions, and other design information needed by production partners. 

• Collaborate with fabricators, printers, rental companies, and other vendors to ensure designs can be realistically produced. 

• Review proofs and production materials for visual accuracy. 

• Make design adjustments when required by venue, budget, timeline, or fabrication constraints. 



What Success Looks Like



• Creative concepts are visually compelling, thoughtful, and aligned with the client’s brand, objectives, audience, and overall event strategy.

• Account Managers can confidently present your creative work to clients with minimal revisions or cleanup. 

• Initial concepts and design drafts are delivered on time and allow enough time for internal review before client deadlines. 

• Renderings, floor plans, mood boards, and presentation decks clearly communicate the creative vision and help clients understand how the experience will come to life. 

• Designs are not only beautiful but also realistic, functional, and buildable within the approved budget, venue restrictions, timeline, and production requirements. 

• Client brand guidelines are consistently and accurately reflected across event environments, signage, stages, activations, décor, and other visual touchpoints. 

• Design files are organized, clearly labeled, current, and easy for the internal team and production partners to locate and understand. 

• Revisions are completed accurately and efficiently, with feedback incorporated thoroughly rather than requiring the same corrections multiple times. 

• Vendor and fabrication partners receive clear creative direction, dimensions, specifications, reference materials, and production-ready information when required. 

• Potential design, fabrication, spatial, budget, or production challenges are identified and communicated early. 

• You proactively provide creative solutions and alternatives when an original idea is not feasible due to budget, venue, timeline, or production limitations. 

• Your work consistently demonstrates strong attention to detail, including spelling, alignment, scale, dimensions, branding, finishes, materials, and overall presentation. 

• Account Managers trust that when a creative assignment is given to you, you will take ownership of it, communicate proactively, meet the deadline, and follow it through to completion. 

• Your creative work helps IMG deliver memorable experiences, strengthen client relationships, and win new business.



Qualifications



• 2+ years of professional experience in event design, experiential design, environmental design, spatial design, production design, or a related creative field required; 3–4 years strongly preferred.

• Prior experience designing for live events, experiential marketing activations, conferences, corporate events, brand experiences, trade shows, pop-ups, or similar environments strongly preferred.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating event, experiential, spatial, environmental, or related design work.

• Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including composition, color, typography, scale, proportion, hierarchy, materials, and spatial flow.

• Ability to translate a creative brief, client objective, or initial idea into a cohesive visual concept and physical experience.

• Ability to interpret floor plans, venue dimensions, measurements, and spatial requirements.

• Understanding of real-world event production considerations, including fabrication, rentals, materials, installation, venue restrictions, guest flow, sightlines, accessibility, and budget.

• Experience creating event renderings, floor plans, elevations, mood boards, presentation decks, environmental graphics, and other visual materials used to communicate creative concepts.

• Proficiency in relevant professional design and rendering software, such as Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, AutoCAD, Vectorworks, or comparable programs.

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and/or InDesign preferred.

• Experience with 3D modeling and rendering software strongly preferred.

• Proficiency with Canva preferred.

• Experience preparing or organizing production-ready artwork and files for printers, fabricators, signage vendors, and other production partners is a plus.

• Strong visual research skills and the ability to identify relevant trends, materials, furnishings, décor, fabrication techniques, and experiential inspiration.

• Strong understanding of branding and the ability to translate brand guidelines into physical environments and experiences.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to reviewing work carefully before internal or client presentation.

• Comfortable receiving creative direction and feedback and making multiple rounds of revisions when necessary.

• Thrives in a fast-paced agency environment with changing priorities, tight deadlines, and multiple projects moving simultaneously.

• Strong organizational, time-management, and communication skills.

• Comfortable collaborating closely with Account Managers, production partners, vendors, fabricators, and other members of the creative team.

• Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with the ability to develop creative alternatives when budget, timing, venue, or production limitations affect the original concept.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying highly communicative, responsive, and accountable.

• Comfortable learning and using project management, file-sharing, event, and agency technology platforms.

Our Core Values

WOW SERVICE: We are committed to great operations. Being accountable, a trusted advisor, and results oriented.

title: B2B Cold Caller — U.S. Web Design Company ($5/hr + $10 Per Qualified Booking)
description:
Elvarrio is a U.S.-based web design company. We build affordable websites for small businesses that don't have one yet — and we need confident cold callers to reach them.



We provide everything: the leads, CloudTalk calling system with a U.S. business number, sales scripts, training, ready-made website demos to send prospects, and our lead tracking system.



Your role: Call small businesses across the United States from our lead lists, speak with owners and decision-makers, introduce Elvarrio's website services using our script, and send the matching demo website. When a prospect is interested, you either connect them live to our owner on the spot or book a call between the prospect and the owner at an exact agreed time. You also follow up with prospects and update our shared lead sheet after every call with accurate outcomes and notes.



You do not close deals, collect payments, or build websites. The owner handles the final sales conversation, agreement, payment, and the project. Your job is real conversations and real bookings.



Schedule & workload:

• Monday–Friday, 10 AM–3 PM U.S. Eastern Time (10 PM–3 AM Philippine Time) — 25 hours/week

• High-volume dialing: 80+ calls per shift, including follow-ups and redials



Pay:

• $5/hour + $10 for every qualified booked call — "qualified" means the prospect genuinely agreed to speak with our owner at a specific day and time

• Starts with a paid 2-week trial. Strong performers stay on as ongoing team members



Please read: All calls are recorded, and booked calls are verified against the recordings daily. We pay for real bookings, and we check. If you're a genuine caller, this protects you — your real work gets seen.



We're looking for:

• Excellent spoken English with a confident, friendly, natural phone presence

• Previous cold-calling / outbound sales experience; calling U.S. businesses strongly preferred

• Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet connection, with a quiet workspace

• Comfortable with Google Sheets and cloud-based calling software

• Available for the full shift, every weekday



Hiring process: Group interview plus a short mock cold call. Selected applicants start with the paid trial.



When applying, tell us about your cold-calling experience — especially calling U.S. businesses — and confirm you can work 10 AM–3 PM Eastern (10 PM–3 AM PH), Monday–Friday.

title: Instagram Social Media Manager | Engagement & Affiliate Outreach
description:
Optimum Formula is a research-use-only e-commerce company with an affiliate and ambassador program. We’re hiring a reliable, experienced Instagram Social Media Manager to handle daily engagement, strengthen affiliate relationships, and connect with potential new partners.



You should enjoy writing, understand how people interact on Instagram, and know how to join a conversation naturally. A thoughtful comment, a well-written introduction, and consistent follow-through are central to this role.



We provide a written engagement SOP and brand guidelines. We need someone who can learn the process, follow it carefully, and take ownership of the daily work.



POSITION DETAILS



• Remote, part-time position

• Approximately 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday

• $5 to $7.50 USD per hour, depending on experience

• Consistent daily availability, with working hours agreed before starting

• Some overlap with U.S. business hours for communication

• Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid skills exercise



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Engage with our affiliates and ambassadors



Review our priority affiliate accounts each workday. Like relevant posts and leave thoughtful, supportive, or witty comments that relate directly to the content.



Your comments should sound like a real person who actually read the caption or watched the video. Use humor when it fits, and adjust your tone to the person and conversation.



2. Find relevant conversations



Identify suitable posts and conversations within our approved fitness, health, and research topics.



Contribute comments that are relevant and useful. Follow our public-comment guidelines, including no peptide mentions, compound names, product promotion, discount codes, or promotional links.



Use good judgment about which conversations to join and which to leave alone.



3. Find and contact potential affiliates



Research creators and potential partners using our qualification guidelines. Consider their content, audience fit, quality of engagement, and existing partnerships.



Write personalized introductory messages that clearly identify Optimum Formula and explain the partnership opportunity using approved information.



Share the affiliate application link after someone expresses interest. Follow our follow-up process, respect declines, and keep each conversation organized.



4. Manage routine comments and messages



Check comments and DMs at the beginning and end of your scheduled workday.



Respond to routine questions using approved information. Pass customer service issues, sensitive questions, and anything outside your responsibilities to the appropriate team member.



Follow our research-use-only communication guidelines. Do not provide medical advice, dosing instructions, human-use recommendations, or unsupported product claims.



5. Track your work and report results



Maintain a simple activity and prospect tracker.



Submit a short daily update covering:



• Affiliate accounts reviewed and engagement completed

• New qualified prospects identified

• Outreach messages and follow-ups sent

• Replies and interested prospects

• Affiliate application links shared and confirmed applications

• Questions, opportunities, or issues needing attention



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Hands-on experience managing Instagram engagement, communities, or influencer outreach for a business

• Excellent written English with a natural, conversational style

• Good judgment about tone, timing, humor, and appropriate conversations

• Ability to follow a written SOP consistently

• Strong attention to detail and dependable daily communication

• Confidence using Google Sheets or a similar tracking tool

• Ability to work independently and apply feedback

• Reliable computer and internet connection



Experience with fitness, bodybuilding, wellness, or research-focused brands is helpful.



All engagement must be manual and personalized. We do not use purchased followers, engagement bots, repetitive bulk comments, or mass messaging.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Our priority affiliates receive consistent attention. Comments fit the posts they appear on. Suitable prospects receive thoughtful introductions. Interested partners receive timely follow-up, and the activity tracker clearly shows what happened and what comes next.



We value strong conversations, qualified interest, and reliable execution.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph. Begin your application with:



OF ENGAGEMENT



Please include the following:



1. Relevant experience



Share up to two Instagram accounts you have managed, or work samples you have permission to share. Explain what you personally handled and describe one result, including the timeframe. Confidential information may be removed.



2. Two sample comments



Write one short, natural comment for each of these posts:



• An existing affiliate celebrates a new deadlift personal record.

• A fitness creator shares how they stayed consistent during a busy week.



Keep each comment specific to the scenario. Do not mention products, peptides, discounts, or our affiliate program.



3. One sample outreach message



Write an introductory DM of no more than 60 words to a fitness educator you believe could be a suitable affiliate.



Introduce Optimum Formula as a research-use-only company and ask whether they would be interested in learning about the affiliate program. Do not include a link or invent product benefits.



4. A judgment question



Describe one situation where you would choose not to comment on a post, and explain why.



5. Availability



Include your desired hourly rate, available working hours in Philippine Time, and earliest start date.



We’ll review your experience, writing samples, attention to detail, and judgment when selecting candidates for the next step.

title: Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: TBD



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Organize takeoffs in accordance with company estimating standards.

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams

* Experience with construction estimating software and PDF plan/specification management systems is a plus

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification rather than make unsupported assumptions

* Able to work during agreed-upon overlapping hours with the U.S.-based team



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
About the Role

This is not a traditional content writing position. We are looking for someone who understands direct response marketing, consumer psychology, and the art of selling through words.



You will be responsible for developing compelling copy for
 marketing campaigns, landing pages, sales funnels, and other customer-facing marketing initiatives.



Beyond writing, you will play an active role in creative ideation, developing marketing angles, identifying customer pain points, and testing new messaging strategies that drive conversions.



The ideal candidate is both a strong writer and a creative thinker who can independently research products, identify opportunities, and develop persuasive marketing concepts.



Key Responsibilities



Copywriting & Content Development

Write compelling, conversion-focused copy for
 campaigns, landing pages, product pages, and sales funnels.

Develop persuasive headlines, hooks, calls to action, and promotional messaging designed to drive customer engagement and sales.

Create engaging
 sequences for product launches, promotional campaigns, customer retention, and abandoned cart recovery.

Translate complex supplement ingredients, product benefits, and scientific information into clear, compelling consumer messaging.

Maintain a consistent brand voice while adapting messaging to different customer audiences and marketing channels.

Creative Ideation & Marketing Angles

Research customer pain points, desires, objections, and buying motivations to develop fresh marketing angles.

Brainstorm and pitch creative concepts, unique selling propositions, hooks, and campaign ideas.



Analyze competitor messaging, market trends, customer reviews, and consumer behavior to identify new opportunities.

Collaborate with the performance marketing and creative teams to develop and test new concepts.

Identify opportunities to reposition existing products through new messaging, storytelling, and value propositions.

Performance & Optimization

Develop copy variations for A/B testing across
 campaigns, landing pages, and sales funnels.

Use performance metrics such as conversion rates, click-through rates, revenue per recipient, and average order value to improve messaging.

Collaborate with marketing teams to identify underperforming content and develop stronger alternatives.

Continuously refine copy based on campaign performance, customer feedback, and business objectives.

Ensure all supplement marketing claims align with brand guidelines and applicable advertising regulations.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience in direct response copywriting, preferably within DTC, eCommerce, supplements, health, wellness, or beauty.

Proven experience writing high-converting
 campaigns, landing pages, and sales funnels.

Strong understanding of consumer psychology, persuasion, storytelling, and conversion rate optimization.

Ability to independently develop creative marketing angles and campaign concepts.

Experience researching target audiences, competitors, and customer pain points.

Ability to interpret marketing performance data and use insights to improve copy.

Strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.



Familiarity with FTC/FDA supplement advertising guidelines is a plus.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who does more than execute a writing brief. We want a creative problem-solver who can bring new ideas to the table.

Someone who can look at a product, understand the customer, identify what makes it compelling, and develop messaging that makes people want to buy.



You should be comfortable testing unconventional angles, challenging existing messaging, and continuously looking for ways to improve marketing performance.
