title: Business Development Associate (WFH / Remote)
description:
Trident Digital | Singapore

Full-time | Remote (Work from Home) | Performance-based

Salary: SGD 300 base + performance bonus (total est. SGD 500–1,000 with commissions)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Every client we work with started as a conversation someone had to start, and a follow-up someone didn't drop. This role owns both.

This is a sales role, not an admin role. You'll reach out to new prospects every day, chase the leads that come in until they book a call with us, and make sure nobody who enquires is left waiting. Your pay scales with your effort and speed: more outreach, faster follow-ups and quicker replies mean you earn more.

If you're fast, reliable, and not afraid to me.



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our BD lead and the founder, so you'll see up close how deals move from first message to signed client. Prospects are financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. You own your outreach and follow-up approach: test what works, drop what doesn't, and keep sharpening it.



What you’ll handle

- Daily outreach. Build lead lists and reach out to prospects every day with personalised messages that give them a real reason to reply

- Lead follow-up. Follow up on leads from our lead sources until they respond and book a call with us

- WhatsApp replies and reminders. Reply to enquiries quickly, send call reminders, and handle reschedules and no-shows

- Tracking. Keep the CRM and tracking sheet up to date, so every prospect, reply and booking is logged



How this role works

- Outreach happens every day, with no misses. Consistency is the job

- Leads don't keep office hours. Enquiries and bookings come in on evenings and weekends too, and you need to be responsive whenever they do. A lead that waits goes cold

- Your pay follows your output. Commissions are tied to results, and you'll see your numbers every week



How you’ll be measured

Outreach sent, follow-ups completed, response speed on enquiries, and calls booked (and shown up to) for the BD lead.



You’ll do well here if you

- Are responsive and on the ball. When a lead messages, you reply. No gaps

- Are motivated by earning more through effort, not by clocking in hours

- Figure out what works instead of waiting to be told. If a message isn't getting replies, you change it

- Are well-spoken and articulate, in writing and out loud. You'd like to grow into handling calls yourself

- Write like a human. Your messages read like a real person, not a template blast

- Sweat the small stuff: names spelled right, reminders sent on time, tracker always current

- Don't take silence personally. Most people won't reply. The ones who do are why the job exists



This is not for you if you

- Want fixed hours where your phone goes off at 6pm and on weekends

- Prefer a steady salary over pay that grows with your effort

- Get discouraged after a week of no's. Resilience isn't optional here, it's the job

- Have freelance work or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

- Sales, BD, outreach or lead generation experience, even informally

- Comfortable with WhatsApp, Google Sheets and CRM tools

- You've handled high message volume without letting quality slip

Fresh grads are welcome to apply. We care more about reliability and hunger than years of experience.



What you get

- Direct exposure to the founder and BD lead. You learn how deals are won, not just how messages are sent

- Commissions that grow with your results, so your ceiling is set by your effort

- A clear path into handling calls and moving into full sales and BD roles as the agency scales

- A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses and overseas team trips



How to apply

 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Business Development Associate - [Your Full Name]



Your
 should include:

- Cover letter: a bit about yourself and why this role fits you

- Updated CV/Resume

- One short exercise: write the first outreach message you'd send to a financial advisor to start a conversation about working with a marketing agency. Keep it short, the kind of message you'd actually send. We're looking at how you write and how you think

- Expected salary in SGD only



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Content Strategist (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working hours: 9am to 6pm SGT

Salary: SGD 1,000



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their field, working in trust-based markets where the people who win are the ones their audience already knows, likes and trusts before the first conversation ever happens. That's what they pay us to build.



This role owns that side of the business. You'll be the strategist behind our clients' brands: d
 what each client should stand for, what angles will make their market remember them, and what content gets made to build that authority month after month. Then you'll sit in front of the client and defend it. We're not hiring a content scheduler. We're hiring someone who can look at a financial advisor's or real estate agent's brand and say "here's why nobody remembers you, and here's what we're doing instead."



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our strategy team, ops manager, projects manager and creative team. Each client gets a real strategy, not a recycled template. Main platforms are
 and Instagram, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate — trust-based industries where the brand does the heavy lifting long before any pitch. Depending on the client, the end goal is winning clients or recruiting new team members, and your job is building the kind of presence that makes either one easier.



What you'll do

• Turn each client's positioning, audience and goals into a clear content strategy: what they stand for, what angles to hit, what to make

• Lead client calls as the strategy contact: present directions, run brainstorms, handle pushback, and keep clients aligned and confident

• Direct the creative team: give direction clear enough to execute without a second meeting, and review outputs against the strategy

• Review performance: spot which angles and formats are working, kill what isn't, and adjust the plan based on evidence

• Keep every client's strategy on track: make sure what gets produced actually follows the direction set, and flag drift or gaps early before they cost results



How you'll be measured

Brand growth and client confidence. Clients whose authority and presence visibly grow — stronger positioning, growing reach, content their market actually engages with and remembers. And clients who renew because they can feel the strategy working. You'll run insights calls with clients to review whether the strategy is delivering — and adjust when it isn't. If you'd rather be measured on outcomes than on how many posts went out, you'll enjoy this.



You'll do well here if you

• Think in brand outcomes first: you ask "what does this client need to be known for?" before you ask "what should we post?"

• Can walk into a client call, present a direction, and hold your ground when it's challenged—with reasoning, not stubbornness

• Study why a piece of content worked, not just that it worked

• Give creatives feedback that makes the work better, not just different

• Communicate proactively. Clients and the team should never have to chase you for an update



This is not for you if you

• Think strategy means a content calendar with theme days

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Chase trends for their own sake. A trending format that doesn't fit a financial advisor's positioning is a distraction, not a strategy

• Avoid client-facing pressure. Presenting, defending and realigning is half this job



No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You've built content strategies for service professionals or personal brands

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors, insurance or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you've done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Real ownership of strategy, working directly with the founder and clients — not three layers removed from the decisions

• Your strategies run on real accounts with real stakes. You see whether your thinking works, fast

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Room to grow into a head of strategy role as the agency scales



How to apply

 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Strategist - [Your Full Name]



Your
 should include:

• Cover letter: years of experience in content or social media strategy and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: 2 to 3 accounts or campaigns you've shaped the strategy for, with a few sentences on each explaining what the strategy was and what it achieved

• One short exercise: find one financial advisor or real estate agent posting content on Instagram or TikTok (any market). In a few lines, tell us what's holding their brand back and the first thing you'd change. We're looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD only



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Video Editor (Contract, CapCut)
description:
Video Editor (Contract, CapCut)

Trident Digital

Contract | 1 month, with possible extension to 2 months

Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Rate: SGD 500–650 monthly



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest-growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry. They don’t pay us for flashy edits. They pay us to make them look like the most credible name in their market, so clients and recruits come to them.



Video is how that happens, and right now we have more footage than editing hands. We’re bringing on a CapCut editor on contract to help us clear a high-volume content push. You’ll edit talking-head content, educational videos, testimonials, interviews, ads, and event trailers that go live on our clients’ pages.



How the contract works

- The contract runs for 1 month to start

- At the end of the month, we review two things: the quality of your edits and your output volume

- If both are strong and the workload is still there, we extend for another month

- No guesswork. You’ll know what we’re measuring from day one



This role is open to CapCut editors only

Our workflow, templates and team all run on CapCut. We’re not looking for Premiere Pro editors who also “know CapCut.” We’re looking for people who can make CapCut edits look premium: clean cuts, good pacing, sharp captions, and motion that supports the message instead of distracting from it.



What the setup looks like

You’ll work with our creative team (strategists, scriptwriters, videographers and designers) and our projects manager, who will brief you and review your work. Main platforms are Instagram and
, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Most content is short-form vertical video. Clients are financial advisors and real estate agents, which means the edit has to build trust, not just grab attention.



What you’ll do

- Edit short-form talking-head videos, educational content, testimonials, interviews, ads and event trailers based on briefs

- Cut for pace and retention: a strong first 3 seconds, no dead air, and a reason for every cut

- Add captions, B-roll, simple motion graphics, intros and outros in CapCut

- Follow each client’s brand style so their content looks consistent across every post

- Submit edits for review, take feedback and turn revisions around quickly

- Keep all project files (raw footage, edits, templates) organised and stored in our shared library



How you’ll be measured

- Quality: how often your edits pass review on the first round, with minimal revisions

- Quantity: 6 to 10 short-form videos a week, depending on complexity

- Turnaround: delivering edits and revisions on time



You’ll see these numbers weekly. They d
 whether the contract is extended.



You’ll do well here if you

- Know CapCut inside out and can make it look better than most people make Premiere look

- Understand that the edit serves the message. The speaker’s credibility comes first, effects come second

- Can work fast without getting sloppy

- Take feedback well. Your edits get reviewed and sometimes reworked. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

- Mainly edit in Premiere Pro, DaVinci or Final Cut and only use CapCut occasionally

- Can’t commit your full working hours (9AM–6PM SGT) for the contract period

- Rely on trending templates and heavy effects instead of thinking about pacing and story

- Need long turnaround times on each video

No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

- You’ve edited content for personal brands, coaches or service professionals

- Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

- Biggest bonus: you’ve edited for the Singapore market



What you get

- Your edits go live on real client accounts. Fast feedback, visible results

- Clear briefs and a team that tells you exactly what good looks like

- A real shot at an extended contract if your quality and output are strong



How to apply

 
 with the subject line:

Contract CapCut Editor - [Your Full Name]



Your
 should include:

- Cover letter: years of editing experience, how long you’ve used CapCut, and your typical weekly output

- Updated CV/Resume

- Proof of CapCut work: a screenshot of one of your CapCut project timelines, and portfolio

- Your availability to start

- Expected monthly rate (in SGD only)



Test edit

Once we’ve reviewed your application, we’ll send you a test edit: raw footage and a short brief to turn into one short-form video. You’ll have 24 hours to submit it. It’s how we see your editing, pacing, and attention to detail firsthand.



The test edit is for assessment only. It will not be published or used on any client account, so treat it purely as a chance to show what you can do.



Important Note: Incomplete applications and test edits submitted after the 24-hour deadline will not be considered. Only CapCut editors will be shortlisted.

title: Wix Conversion & Optimisation Specialist — Human Frequency
description:
Wix Conversion & Optimisation Specialist — Human Frequency



Human Frequency is looking for a Wix specialist who understands what makes a landing page effective and how to use Wix to support enquiries and bookings.



We need someone who can review our pages and the systems behind them, identify what’s working, explain what needs improving and help us make better use of the platform.



This role focuses on auditing, optimisation and Wix configuration. Website development, coding and design production are not your responsibility. You will need enough understanding of effective page design to give clear recommendations to the people doing that work.



What you’ll do

- Review our landing pages and booking journey

- Assess how visitors move from the landing page through buttons, forms and booking steps to confirmation. Identify confusing instructions, unnecessary steps, broken links or other issues that could prevent someone from enquiring or booking.

- Recommend improvements to page presentation

- Review headline readability, font size and weight, capitalisation, spacing, content hierarchy, button placement and mobile usability. Explain how your recommendations could help visitors understand the offer and take the next step.

- We want recommendations supported by evidence and sensible testing, rather than blanket rules about what always converts.

- Review and improve Wix settings and automations

- Understand how our forms, bookings, contact records, confirmation
s and reminders connect. Identify missing, duplicated or incorrect actions, and configure improvements using Wix’s built-in tools. Flag anything that requires a developer or another specialist.

- Audit and improve SEO

- Review page titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, URLs, internal links, image descriptions, indexing and relevant Wix SEO settings. Identify opportunities to improve visibility for the people and locations we serve.

- Review tracking and performance

- Check how we measure page visits, button clicks, enquiries and bookings. Identify gaps in tracking and help us understand where visitors drop off. Clearly distinguish what the data shows from what still needs testing.

- Help us use Wix more effectively

- Identify useful Wix features we could use better. Explain the benefit, priority and any limitations before recommending additional tools or changes.



What we need from you

Strong practical knowledge of Wix, including landing pages, forms, bookings, automations, SEO and analytics.

The ability to assess conversion and usability without needing to design or code the website yourself.

Clear recommendations showing what to keep, fix, improve and test.

The ability to explain technical issues in simple language and work with our team.

Honest judgement about what you know, what needs checking and when another specialist is needed.

title: Real Estate Acquisition & Sales Specialist (Remote)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a **highly skilled Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer** to join our team long-term.



This is **not primarily a cold-calling position**. Our marketing and lead-generation team identifies homeowners who have expressed interest in selling and pre-qualifies them before handing qualified opportunities to the Acquisition Specialist.



Your primary responsibility will be to speak with motivated homeowners, understand their situation, build trust, negotiate pricing and terms, follow up consistently, and ultimately **get profitable real estate contracts signed**.



We currently generate seller opportunities through multiple channels, including **iSpeedToLead, DataSift, SMS marketing, Smarter Contact, Kixie, and our CRM**. Our goal is to build a highly systemized acquisition department where qualified seller opportunities are contacted quickly and no valuable lead falls through the cracks.



Our primary transaction strategy is **novation**, followed by wholesale/assignment when appropriate. We selectively purchase properties ourselves when the profit opportunity is exceptional.



You will work closely with our current Acquisition Manager, operations team, lead-generation team, and company owner. Initially, you will learn our existing acquisition process and work alongside our current Acquisition Manager. The goal is for you to eventually become capable of **independently managing and closing qualified seller opportunities from beginning to end**.



### Responsibilities & Expectations



- Call qualified homeowners who have indicated an interest in selling.

- Respond quickly to newly qualified seller opportunities.

- Build rapport and uncover the seller's true motivation, timeline, condition, financial situation, and desired outcome.

- Negotiate purchase prices and transaction structures professionally and confidently.

- Explain cash offers, novation transactions, and other selling solutions clearly to homeowners.

- Maintain consistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready to make a decision immediately.

- Work leads through the CRM until they sell, contract with us, or are otherwise no longer viable.

- Use **Kixie** for outbound calling and follow-up.

- Maintain detailed CRM notes so another team member can immediately understand each seller's situation.

- Work closely with the lead-qualification team to improve the quality of leads being transferred to acquisitions.

- Bring complicated or unusually valuable opportunities to management for deal review.

- Participate in call reviews, coaching, and ongoing sales training.

- Become capable of covering for the Acquisition Manager when he is unavailable.

- Ultimately produce approximately **4–6 signed contracts per month** once fully trained and supplied with adequate qualified lead volume.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is **comfortable talking about money, asking difficult questions, negotiating, handling objections, and asking homeowners to make decisions**.



The ideal candidate has prior experience in **U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, investor sales, high-ticket telephone sales, or another negotiation-heavy sales position**.



Excellent spoken English is extremely important. You should sound natural, confident, professional, empathetic, and trustworthy when speaking with U.S. homeowners.



You should also be:



- Highly dependable and available during agreed U.S. business hours.

- Competitive but ethical.

- Persistent without being aggressive.

- Comfortable receiving coaching and having calls reviewed.

- Organized with strong CRM discipline.

- Able to follow a sales process while still thinking independently.

- Comfortable making numerous follow-up calls every day.

- Able to recognize seller motivation and negotiate creatively.

- Comfortable discussing property values, mortgages, equity, repairs, and seller expectations.

- Motivated by measurable results rather than simply completing tasks.



## What This Job Is NOT



This is not a position where success is measured by simply making a large number of calls.



We care about:



**Qualified seller conversations → signed contracts → closed transactions → gross profit.**



Our lead-generation team will do much of the initial prospecting and qualification. Your job is to take valuable seller opportunities and **convert them into contracts**.



## Training & Growth



You will initially work closely with our existing Acquisition Manager and review real seller conversations, successful deals, objection handling, negotiation strategies, and our novation process.



We are building redundancy into our acquisition department, so our objective is to have **multiple Acquisition Specialists capable of independently closing deals at a high level**.



Strong performers will have opportunities to take on significantly more responsibility as the company grows.



## Schedule



**Full-time position.**



You must be able to work hours that overlap substantially with U.S. business hours and be available when homeowners are most likely to answer their phones.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview.



## Compensation



**Competitive base compensation plus performance incentives/bonuses based on results.**



Compensation will depend on experience, communication ability, and demonstrated sales skill.



Top performers should have the opportunity to earn substantially more as their contract production increases.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short explanation of your previous sales, real estate, acquisitions, or negotiation experience.

2. Your experience speaking with U.S.-based customers.

3. Your experience using CRMs and telephone dialing systems.

4. Your experience with real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, novations, or motivated sellers, if applicable.

5. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be successful negotiating with U.S. homeowners.

6. Your desired hourly/monthly compensation.

7. Your internet speed and backup internet/power setup.

8. Put the words **“Acquisition Closer”** in the subject line of your application so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



**VOICE RECORDING MANDATORY**. Since this person's job is almost entirely seller communication,

Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Estimating Assistant to support Advanced Framing Structures (AFS), a Southern California commercial rough-carpentry and wood-framing subcontractor. In this role, you will process bid invitations, download and organize project documents, maintain accurate bid records in HubSpot, and prepare plan files and overlays in PlanSwift. You will work closely with the estimating team to ensure bid opportunities, deadlines, and project documents are complete, organized, and ready for review. 



The ideal candidate has strong administrative processing skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures consistently. Construction experience is helpful but not required. This is an administrative support role, not an independent estimating, pricing, or decision-making position.



Key Responsibilities:

Bid Invitation Administration

* Monitor assigned estimating
 inboxes, bid portals, and other sources for new Invitations to Bid (ITBs).

* Download bid invitations and related project documents, including plans, specifications, addenda, bid instructions, and available project information.

* Enter or update bid opportunity information in HubSpot and other company tracking systems.

* Record bid due dates, project names, General Contractor information, locations, and other required opportunity details.

* Respond to bid invitations using approved company responses and direction from the estimating team.

* Record whether AFS intends to bid, decline, or requires estimator review before responding.

* Flag duplicate invitations, missing documents, unclear due dates, addenda, or other issues for estimator review.



Bid Document Organization

* Create and maintain organized electronic bid folders using AFS naming and filing standards.

* Save plans, specifications, addenda, bid forms, and other documents in the correct project folder.

* Maintain current versions of documents and clearly identify revised or superseded plan sets when directed.

* Notify the assigned estimator when new plans, addenda, or material bid documents are received.

* Help maintain an accurate and easy-to-follow electronic record for each bid opportunity.



PlanSwift Support

* Upload/import project plan sets into PlanSwift.

* Organize and label plan pages so estimators can locate drawings efficiently.

* Verify basic page orientation and plan-file completeness before handing the file to the estimator.

* Set up plan overlays to compare revised drawings against prior plan versions using the company's established process.

* Identify and flag apparent drawing changes shown by overlays for estimator review.

* Do not independently determine the estimating, scope, cost, or schedule impact of drawing changes.



HubSpot / CRM Administration

* Create and update bid opportunities, companies, contacts, due dates, stages, and activity information in HubSpot.

* Maintain clean and consistent CRM records and avoid duplicate companies, contacts, or opportunities.

* Update opportunity status based on direction from the estimating team.

* Assist with routine CRM data cleanup, record maintenance, and reporting support as assigned.

* HubSpot experience is preferred but not required, as training may be provided to candidates with strong administrative skills.



Estimating Team Support

* Maintain bid calendars, trackers, and administrative task lists as assigned.

* Assist estimators with locating, downloading, renaming, organizing, and distributing bid documents.

* Perform routine data entry and document-preparation tasks related to estimating.

* Follow up internally when information or direction is needed to complete an assigned administrative task.

* Support other routine estimating administrative work consistent with the level and purpose of the position.



Required Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in administrative support, data entry, document control, CRM administration, accounts payable, construction administration, estimating support, or a similar role is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when handling repetitive tasks and high volumes of administrative information.

* Excellent digital file management and organizational skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.

* Experience downloading, uploading, renaming, organizing, and managing digital documents, especially large PDF files.

* Good written English and the ability to prepare concise, professional
s and communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to follow written instructions, established procedures, checklists, and naming conventions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying missing information, conflicting dates, duplicate records, revised documents, and other discrepancies.

* Ability to verify information, check work for errors, and use organized systems to maintain accuracy rather than relying solely on memory.

* Willingness to ask questions and escalate unclear instructions rather than guess or make unsupported assumptions.

* Ability to learn new software and workflows quickly and demonstrate tasks through screen sharing when required.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable performing repetitive, process-driven administrative work.

* Ability to work independently within clearly defined responsibilities and maintain reliable follow-through on assigned tasks.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule aligned with AFS's Southern California operations.



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with PlanSwift; familiarity with Bluebeam or similar PDF and plan-document software is an advantage.

* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

* Previous experience in construction administration, estimating support, bid coordination, or document control.

* Familiarity with construction plans, specifications, bid invitations, addenda, and general construction terminology.

* Experience using trackers, checklists, and standardized filing systems to maintain accurate records and prevent errors.

* Note: PlanSwift and HubSpot experience is preferred but not required.



Working Conditions

* This position focuses on administrative processing, document management, CRM maintenance, and plan preparation to support the estimating team.

* The employee will not make independent bid/no-bid decisions or determine which project scope should be included or excluded.

* Establishing labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, markup, or final bid pricing is outside the scope of this role.

* Independent final quantity takeoffs, estimating approvals, pricing negotiations, and contract decisions are not part of the position.

* The employee must not submit final proposals or make commitments on behalf of AFS without authorization.

* Plan overlays are prepared to help identify drawing revisions. Determining their scope, cost, or scheduling impact is the responsibility of the estimator.

* Missing documents, conflicting information, unclear instructions, and unusual requests must be escalated to the assigned estimator or estimating leader.

* The employee is expected to maintain organized records, follow established procedures, and communicate progress or issues promptly to the estimating team.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Remote Sales & Enrollment Rep — Dance Studio (Part Time to Full Time Opportunity).
description:
IF SALES CONVERSATIONS ENERGIZE YOU AND YOU HATE LETTING A LEAD GO COLD, THIS ROLE WAS BUILT FOR YOU.



We are a dance studio that has built something real in our community. What we do goes far beyond teaching dance. We build confidence, friendships, leadership, and skills that stay with people for life. Every family that reaches out to us is already looking for that. Your job is to make sure they find it, and to bring more people into what we are building.



We are hiring one person to own this role. Not manage it. Own it.





WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is a part time, remote sales role. The heart of it is outbound and inbound outreach to warm leads, real people who have already expressed interest in the studio. Your job is to be the first voice they hear, build genuine connection quickly, and guide them toward enrollment through real conversations.



When lead flow is strong, you are following up. When there is downtime, you are prospecting, going out and finding new families through social media, community groups, and online platforms. You are not waiting for things to come to you. You are making them happen.



You will also support the studio with weekly
s to leads and occasionally contribute to social media content. These are a small part of the role, but they are consistent and they count.



This role has a real growth path. If you are consistently converting leads and bringing new families into the studio, the hours are there to grow with you. The right person will not stay part time for long.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Contact new leads immediately when they come in. Speed is a real advantage in enrollment. First contact almost always wins.



- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured cadence.



- Manage your pipeline and know where every lead stands at all times. Log your activity and report daily.



- Prospect for new leads during downtime through social media, community groups, and online platforms.



- Write weekly
s to leads and support social media content as needed.



- Show up as a true team player. The studio owner may occasionally bring you into tasks outside your core scope. If it supports the studio's growth, you are in. That flexibility and willingness to contribute is something we value deeply in whoever joins this team.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



These are our priorities, in order:



- Phone presence above everything else. You need to sound calm, natural, and confident on every call. Not scripted. Not stiff. The kind of person who can hold a real conversation, earn trust quickly, and move it forward without forcing anything. If that description fits you, you are already ahead of most applicants.



- Fluent in spoken and written English at a C1 level or higher. This will be assessed.



- Experienced in sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment based roles.



- Organized and reliable. You manage your leads, report your activity, and stay on top of follow ups without needing reminders.



- Self directed and comfortable working independently.



- Energized by conversations and motivated by real results.



- Familiar with CRM tools or lead tracking systems. Helpful but not required.



A background or interest in dance is a nice bonus. It is absolutely not required.





SCHEDULE



20 hours per week across 7 days.

Current Schedule (Pacific Time):



Monday–Friday:

- 11:00–11:30 AM

- 12:30–1:30 PM

- 4:00–6:00 PM



Saturday–Sunday:

- 10:00–11:15 AM



Important: This is a split shift schedule, and weekend availability is required.



Hours may change seasonally based on the studio's needs, with shifts scheduled between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM Pacific Time. Any changes will be discussed and agreed upon in advance.



We are looking for someone who can reliably work the current schedule and has reasonable flexibility for future adjustments.





TWO WEEK TRIAL PERIOD (Paid)



The role begins with a 2 week trial period to make sure there is a strong fit on both sides. During this time, we will be looking closely at reliability, communication, follow through, organization, quality of work, and how effectively you manage leads without needing constant direction.



At the end of the 2 weeks, we will review performance together and d
 whether to continue the role long term.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid bi weekly via Wise.



This starts as a part time role. If you are consistently bringing new families into the studio, even a handful a month, there is a genuine path to full time. We want to give more hours to someone who is making the most of the ones they have. Results open doors here.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Every family that contacts this studio is already hoping for something meaningful. A place where their child grows. A community they can belong to. Your follow up, your voice, your consistency, that is what turns their interest into a yes. The right person in this role does not just fill a position. They change outcomes for real families.





TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short introduction. Tell us about a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a real difference.



Include "Buzz Lightyear" in your subject line or message title. We read every application that includes it. Think of it as the first small sign that you are someone who reads carefully and follows through, two things that matter a lot in this role.

title: Client Sales Representative

description:
Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)



Compensation: Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 100,000+ per month, depending on individual sales performance. This role offers a competitive compensation structure with commissions and performance incentives that reward high achievers.



Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.



Leave: One week paid leave per year.



About the Client



Our client is Australia's leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating long-term career opportunities for motivated individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, customer-focused sales role centred on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires excellent multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence in managing time-sensitive situations.



Team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have opportunities for career progression into leadership positions and may eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations

Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-paced dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet or exceed individual sales targets and performance KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum two (2) years' experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience supporting Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What's in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 120,000+ per month

- Commission and incentive structure that rewards strong sales performance

- Clear career progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and professional development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work environment

- Long-term career growth for high-performing team members

title: Outbound Sales Development Manager (SDR Manager) – U.S. B2B Security Services
description:
Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Pacific Business Hours

Compensation: $7-$10/hr USD/hour + Monthly Performance Bonuses

Position: Long-Term, Full-Time Remote



We are a growing California-based private security company providing security guard services, mobile vehicle patrols, security towers, temporary security and other security solutions to commercial clients throughout California.



We are looking for an experienced *Outbound Sales Development Manager / SDR Manager* to build, manage and continuously improve our outbound sales development team.



This is not an administrative sales-manager position.



You will be responsible for building a high-performance outbound sales operation that generates qualified appointments and recurring sales opportunities for our senior security consultants.



What You Will Own



You will be responsible for:



* Recruiting and screening SDRs / outbound sales representatives

* Interviewing and selecting strong cold-calling talent

* Onboarding and training new SDRs

* Conducting daily sales huddles

* Monitoring SDR activity and conversion KPIs

* Reviewing recorded sales calls

* Scoring calls and providing coaching

* Improving cold-call scripts and objection handling

* Maintaining sales pipelines inside GoHighLevel

* Ensuring accurate CRM notes, opportunity stages and follow-up tasks

* Building and maintaining lead-generation processes

* Researching target companies using Google, business directories, company websites and other sources

* Training SDRs to identify and research prospects

* Developing prospecting campaigns by industry and geographic territory

* Monitoring appointment quality and show rates

* Working with our Senior Security Consultants to improve lead quality

* Maintaining weekly, monthly and quarterly pipeline reports

* Identifying underperforming SDRs and creating improvement plans

* Recruiting replacements when necessary

* Building a repeatable outbound sales operation capable of scaling



Industries We Target



Our security services are sold across numerous industries, including:



* Property Management

* Multifamily / Apartments

* HOAs

* Warehousing and Logistics

* Construction

* Shopping Centers

* Retail

* Hotels and Hospitality

* Healthcare

* Manufacturing

* Automotive Dealerships

* Schools and Educational Facilities

* Commercial Real Estate

* Industrial Facilities

* Utilities and Infrastructure

* Vacant Properties

* Events

* Government and Public Agencies



Because we target many industries, the ability to rapidly research new markets and develop prospecting strategies is extremely important.



Our Sales Process



Our SDRs primarily contact businesses through outbound cold calling and follow-up.



The SDR's responsibility is to identify the appropriate decision maker, understand the prospect's potential security needs, qualify the opportunity and schedule a meeting with one of our Senior Security Consultants.



The Senior Security Consultant conducts the detailed discovery call, determines scope, prepares the security proposal and works toward closing the account.



We primarily target recurring contracts for security guards, mobile patrols and security towers, while also pursuing temporary security assignments and RFP opportunities.



Systems



Our primary CRM is *GoHighLevel*.



You must be comfortable managing:



* Contacts

* Opportunities

* Sales pipelines

* Tasks

* Tags

* Custom fields

* Call activity

* Follow-up workflows

* Sales reporting

* Agent performance



Prior GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred.



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* 3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience

* Previous experience managing SDRs, appointment setters or cold callers

* Experience selling to U.S. businesses

* Strong spoken English

* Strong written English

* Experience recruiting sales representatives

* Experience conducting call QA and coaching

* Experience creating scripts and objection-handling frameworks

* Strong CRM discipline

* Experience managing sales KPIs

* Strong prospect-research skills

* Experience building outbound pipelines from scratch

* Strong leadership and accountability skills



BPO, call-center management, outsourced sales management, security services, property-management sales or other B2B service experience is highly desirable.



How Performance Will Be Measured



We measure performance using real business outcomes, including:



* SDR productivity

* Qualified conversations

* Qualified appointments held

* Appointment show rates

* Qualified opportunities created

* Pipeline generated

* Security guard hours generated

* Monthly recurring revenue generated

* Proposal opportunities

* Closed accounts

* Call quality

* CRM accuracy

* SDR improvement

* Recruiting and retention



Application Requirements



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your experience managing outbound sales teams.

3. The largest number of SDRs or sales representatives you have directly managed.

4. The industries you have sold into.

5. The CRMs you have used.

6. Your experience with GoHighLevel.

7. Your experience recruiting sales representatives.

8. Your typical daily outbound-call expectations for an SDR.

9. The KPIs you believe an outbound SDR team should be measured on.

10. A brief explanation of how you would coach an SDR who is making enough calls but not booking qualified appointments.



Applicants who successfully complete the initial interview process may be asked to complete a *paid practical sales-management assessment* involving prospect research, call review, coaching and CRM/pipeline strategy.



We are looking for a manager who can build a department—not someone who simply monitors one.

title: Direct Response Copywriter (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000+ monthly (with performance bonuses)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry, and they don’t pay us for views or pretty content. They pay us for leads, booked calls and closed business.



This role is a big part of that engine. Your job is to come up with strong angles for each client, and then write everything that carries those angles: video ad scripts, image ads, landing page copy, VSL scripts, Meta ad copy, and follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages. Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets, and you’ll know within days whether it worked. If that excites you, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You’ll join our ads department and work alongside team members with different specialist skill sets across media buying, funnels and creative, plus our strategists and the founder. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast. Main channel is Meta. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate, which means trust-based selling.



What you’ll do

• Come up with strong angles for each client based on their positioning, audience and offer

• Write high converting video ad scripts, image ad copy, VSL scripts, landing page copy and Meta ad copy

• Write follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages that keep leads moving towards booked calls

• Review results weekly with the ads lead, spot the winning angles, and write the next round based on data

• Write for real Singapore FA and RE audiences based on what they actually think and want. No generic “financial freedom” filler

• Build our angle library as you go, so every winning angle compounds for the whole team



How you’ll be measured

Hit rate. Out of every batch of scripts you write, a minimum share needs to become winners: strong lead costs, campaigns that can scale. Our current bar is at least 2 winners out of every 8 video scripts. You’ll see your numbers every week. Good writers want to be measured. It’s how you prove you’re good.



You’ll do well here if you

• Care about the difference between copy that reads well and copy that converts, and chase the second

• Rewrite your own hooks before anyone asks

• Study why an ad worked, not just that it worked

• Take feedback well. Your copy gets reviewed, tested and sometimes rewritten. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

• Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We’re not saying no life outside work. We’re saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Prefer writing from templates instead of thinking through the audience and angle each time



No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You’ve written copy for service professionals

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you’ve done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets. Fast feedback, real stakes, visible results

• Direct access to the founder and strategists. You learn how campaigns are actually planned, not just briefed

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Real room to grow into a senior copy and strategy role as we scale



How to apply



 
 with the subject line: 

Your Next Copywriter - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

• Cover letter: years of copywriting experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: your 3 best pieces of ad copy or scripts, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining the choices you made

• One short exercise: pick any ad you’ve seen that you think is weak, and rewrite the hook. A few lines is enough. We’re looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized Transaction Coordinator to manage our real estate transactions from contract to close. Daily & Ongoing Coordination

 & Communication: Serve as a primary contact for transaction-related
s. Clear document requirements, proactively follow up on missing files, and chase down outstanding signatures.



SkySlope Management: Upload, organize, and assign documents to the correct files daily. Continuously update transaction statuses to ensure compliance.

title: Multifamily Acquisition Coordinator
description:
BTX HOMES SOLUTIONS

Part-Time Multifamily Acquisition Coordinator



Remote | North Carolina Investment Focus | Initial 90-Day Contract



About BTX Homes Solutions



BTX Homes Solutions is building a multifamily acquisition business focused on purchasing small apartment properties throughout North Carolina. Our strategy emphasizes 10–60 unit properties, owner-direct opportunities, creative financing and long-term cash flow.



We are seeking a dependable, organized acquisition coordinator who can run the daily acquisition workflow with minimal supervision.



Primary objective

Build and manage a consistent pipeline of qualified multifamily acquisition opportunities, with a preferred purchase price of $2,000,000 or less, while identifying sellers open to seller financing and other creative acquisition structures.

Responsibilities



Research North Carolina multifamily markets and identify properties with 10–60 units.



Build owner lists using county tax records, GIS systems, property records, public data and approved real estate databases.



Identify long-term owners, vacant or underperforming properties, estate-related opportunities and potential seller-financing candidates.

Contact owners and brokers by phone,
 and other legally permitted methods.



Maintain consistent follow-up and document every interaction in the CRM.



Request asking prices, rent rolls, trailing 12-month operating statements, occupancy data and information about property condition.



Screen properties using the company buy box and underwriting spreadsheet.



Ask sellers whether they would consider installment payments, seller financing or other flexible sale terms.



Research potential commercial lenders, asset-based lenders and prospective joint-venture capital partners.



Coordinate preliminary property management estimates, inspections and professional due diligence after authorization.



Deliver a weekly acquisition report showing pipeline status, deal economics, financing possibilities and next actions.



Improve written procedures and eventually help recruit and train additional team members.



Required skills

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organization and follow-through.

Experience with real estate research, lead generation, acquisitions, property management or commercial real estate.

Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems,
 and online public records.

Ability to learn basic multifamily underwriting, including gross rent, operating expenses, NOI, debt service and cash flow.

Professional phone manner and respectful negotiation skills.

Ability to work independently and report measurable results.

Performance expectations



During the first 30 days, the coordinator must establish the CRM, build the initial owner database, begin outreach, create follow-up routines and demonstrate accurate property screening.



By day 60, the coordinator should have active owner conversations, financial documents on interested properties and preliminary financing research.



By day 90, the coordinator should have a repeatable acquisition process and a documented pipeline of qualified opportunities.

Initial planning targets include 50–100 new owner records researched per week, 40–60 owner outreach attempts, 40–60 follow-up attempts and approximately 10 properties screened financially. 



Targets will be adjusted to match working hours, list quality and actual results. Qualified opportunities matter more than raw activity.



Compensation and working arrangement

Part-time contractor engagement, initially approximately 10–15 hours per week.



Proposed starting budget: $400–$600 per month for the initial scope, subject to candidate experience, hours and agreed deliverables.



Paid trial with defined milestones before extending the engagement.

Any incentive or success fee must be agreed in writing and reviewed for legal compliance before implementation.

Authority and reporting

The coordinator may conduct approved research, outreach, follow-up and preliminary analysis independently. The coordinator may not sign purchase contracts, commit company funds, incur unapproved expenses, promise investor returns or bind the company to financing or partnership agreements.



The coordinator reports directly to the owner through a concise weekly dashboard and escalates only material decisions requiring approval.



Application instructions



Please provide:

A summary of your real estate acquisition or research experience.

An example of a property lead list or underwriting spreadsheet you have prepared, with confidential information removed.

The tools and public-record systems you have used.

Your proposed weekly availability and monthly compensation.

A short written explanation of how you would find 10–20 unit apartment buildings owned by sellers who may consider financing part of the purchase price.

title: Web and UI Designer
description:
ABOUT illumination



illumination is a fractional Chief Marketing Officer practice founded by Mandy MacPhee. I help leaders in financial services build the marketing foundations their companies need to grow past what instinct and effort alone can carry. Clients include wealth management firms, fintech companies and professional services businesses across North America.

illumination is an AI-forward practice. AI is part of how the work gets produced every day, from imagery and copy through to website builds. Figma designs feed directly into AI build tools, which gets approved designs into production faster. That puts a lot of weight on how your Figma files are structured. The AI builds from exactly what is in the file, so your naming, auto layout and components all show up in the finished site.

The team is small, and you will work directly with me. No account manager or corporate layer sits between you and the work. Clients see your designs first, so quality and consistency carry a lot of weight here.

ABOUT THE ROLE



I am hiring a Web and UI Designer to design client websites and landing pages in Figma. You will take each project from wireframe to final, development-ready design. A developer builds from your files, so this role involves no coding or CMS work.

Website work takes most of your time. The rest goes to graphic design and video for client campaigns, including social media graphics, ad creatives,
 templates, custom imagery, video editing and motion graphics.

Hours range from 15 to 30 per week, depending on the client work in progress. The role is ongoing.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



-Wireframes and User Flow

Before any visual design starts, you will map how a visitor moves through the site. That covers which pages exist, how they link, what each page needs to say and where the contact points sit. Wireframes are low fidelity and carry no branding. I review and approve them before high-fidelity work begins.



-Website and Landing Page Design

You will design full websites, single pages and campaign landing pages. Approved wireframes become high-fidelity designs with final typography, colour, imagery and components. Every design needs desktop and mobile versions. Layouts should move visitors toward one clear action, such as booking a call or submitting a form.



-Clickable Prototypes

You will link Figma pages into prototypes so clients and I can click through a site from start to finish before it goes to development. That includes interactive elements like accordions, tabs and form layouts.



-Design Systems and Components

For each client, you will set up a Figma design system with colour and type styles, spacing rules, buttons, form fields, cards and reusable components. Pages get built from those components. The site stays consistent, and new pages take less time to produce.



-Handoff to Production

Your Figma files go into AI build tools such as Claude and Google AI Studio. A developer finishes and launches the site from there. You will structure every file so both the AI and the developer can read it: named layers and frames, auto layout throughout, components instead of one-off elements, and specs in Dev Mode. You will also export assets, note interactions and responsive behaviour, answer questions during the build, and check the live site against your designs.



-Multi-Brand Design

Each client has its own brand guidelines. You will move between brand systems without mixing visual identities, and every piece you produce follows that client's brand standards.



-Digital Graphic Design

You will produce social media graphics, digital ad creatives in multiple sizes,
 templates and web graphics. There is less of this than website work, but it is steady.



-Video Editing and Motion Design

You will edit video for client campaigns and social media. That means cutting footage from different sources, adding branded titles, captions, overlays and transitions, and exporting final files sized for each channel. You will also design motion graphics, such as animated social posts, short promotional clips and animated elements for websites.



-Custom and AI-Generated Imagery

You will create custom visuals for client sites and campaigns, including composited images and illustrations. For some clients, you will generate images with AI tools such as Gemini and then edit them to production standard. Raw AI output is a starting point. I expect it refined before it goes into a design.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



Required

-At least 3 years of web or UI design experience, with a portfolio that includes live websites built from your designs.

-Have a good command of English language.

-Advanced Figma skills, including auto layout, components and variants, styles and variables, prototyping and Dev Mode handoff.

-Hands-on experience using Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work. You should be comfortable writing detailed prompts, refining output over several rounds, and recognizing when the output needs more work before it can be used.

-Experience creating wireframes and turning them into high-fidelity designs.

-Responsive design for desktop, tablet and mobile.

-Enough understanding of how sites get built to design layouts a developer can produce in Webflow, WordPress, Squarespace or GoHighLevel.

-Working knowledge of accessibility basics like colour contrast, readable type sizes and well-labelled forms.

-Video editing and motion design skills, with samples in your portfolio. You can edit footage, add branded titles, captions and transitions, and create animated graphics for social media and the web in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or similar tools.

-Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

-Canva Pro for fast social media production.

-Experience with AI image generation (Gemini, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly or similar), and the editing skill to bring that output to production quality.

-Strong written English. Briefs and status updates are in English, and I expect you to ask questions when a brief is unclear.

A reliable internet connection, a computer that runs Figma, Adobe tools and video editing software without lag, and a distraction-free place to work.



Preferred

-Design experience in financial services, wealth management, fintech or professional services.

-Agency or freelance experience managing several client brands at once.

-Experience with AI tools that build from Figma files, such as Claude through the Figma connector, Google AI Studio or Figma Make.

-An eye for conversion, including page hierarchy, headline placement and how layout affects form completion.

-Experience using Notion for briefs and project tracking.



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following:

-Your resume or CV.

-A portfolio link with at least two website projects. For each one, include the wireframes, the final Figma designs and a link to the live site. Also include at least two video or motion graphics samples.

-A 3 to 5 minute Loom video walking me through one website project from wireframe to launch. Cover the brief, the structure and layout decisions you made, and how the handoff to development went. Include one example of how you use Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT in your design process.



Start your application with the word "wireframe" so I know you read the full posting.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a design test. You will receive a brand guideline file and a wireframe, then design one website page in Figma at desktop and mobile sizes, with components set up and the file ready for developer handoff. Your file will be run through an AI build tool, so file structure is part of how the test is scored.



We especially value applicants who follow instructions carefully. See you online!

title: Immediate start Direct Response Video Ads Editor
description:
We're an ecommerce brand scaling our Meta ads, and we need an editor who makes video ads that convert, not just ads that look good.

You'll build ads from B-roll we provide, along with room to bring your own broll/ideas. We're looking for someone who wants a long-term, exclusive role and to grow with the brand.



What you'll do

* Edit direct-response video ads with provided voice overs

* Use performance feedback to make each round of ads better



What we look for in your work

* Relatability: Viewers see themselves in the first 3 seconds through age, environment, lifestyle and frustration. Real homes and real people. know who the ad is selling to and match it visually

* Congruency: B-roll matches the exact line being spoken, especially when explaining the mechanism. No generic filler clips.

* Hook visuals: Visuals and copy line up from frame one. Nothing Meta will flag in the hook. The visual carries the sensitive part of the problem so the copy doesn't have to say it.

* Show, don't tell: The mechanism is demonstrated, not just described. Results are shown in real time with labels like Day 1 and Day 10.

* Proof: Real before/after footage. The product is shown in use, not just held. It's revealed late when the story earns it.

* Authority: A real face, even for 2–3 seconds, to anchor the "we/us" peer voice.

* Text and format: Short hook text that fits on screen. Native-looking UI like comment-reply stickers.

* Pacing: No dead or repetitive footage. Every cut earns the next second.



*Important*: We also want someone who can create Collage video ads using images. 



If you don’t understand the above, do not apply.



Requirements

* Proven experience editing DR ads for ecommerce brands

* Fast turnaround without dropping quality

* Clear communication



How to apply Start your application with: "I create high-converting video ads."



Then include:

* Links to 2–3 of your best ecommerce or DR ads.

* A short summary of your DR editing experience

* Your availability and how soon you can start



We are looking for immidiate start.

title: WordPress Gutenberg / Block Developer – Contract, Remote
description:
About the Position

We are a U.S. based marketing agency seeking an experienced WordPress Gutenberg / Block Developer to support ongoing client website and landing page projects.

This is a hands-on development position for someone who can work independently, take a project through development and QA, troubleshoot issues, and deliver clean, responsive, production-ready WordPress websites.

Strong Gutenberg experience is required.

Our websites are built primarily using the native WordPress Gutenberg / Block Editor and proof of experience using this platform is REQUIRED. If your WordPress experience is primarily based on Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, or similar page builders, your experience will not meet our requirements for this position.



What You’ll Be Doing

You will work with our agency partners and project team to:

• Build complete WordPress websites using Gutenberg and native WordPress functionality

• Build custom Gutenberg blocks

• Create and manage block patterns and reusable/synced patterns

• Develop and customize WordPress themes and child themes

• Build conversion-focused landing pages

• Modify and improve existing WordPress websites

• Integrate WordPress websites with third-party platforms and APIs

• Troubleshoot plugin, theme, compatibility, and performance issues

• Optimize websites for speed and Core Web Vitals

• Ensure proper responsive behavior across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

• Follow accessibility and WCAG best practices

• Create and work within staging environments

• Manage backups and rollback procedures before major changes

• Configure and troubleshoot SSL

• Deploy approved changes from staging to production

• Perform cross-browser and device testing

• Provide ongoing WordPress maintenance and troubleshooting

• Estimate development hours before beginning assigned projects

• Document custom development when appropriate



Additional Tech Stack Used

• Smart Slider 3

• Google Site Kit

• Insert Scripts/Snippets 

• Gravity Forms, WPforms Contact Forms 7 and custom CSS styling with HTML 

• Link Whisperer

• Rank Math Pro

• Some Elementor client work may be required 

• Call Tracking Metrics, Callrail, or Liine

• Advanced Custom Fields 

• Woocommerce 

• Google Recaptcha

• CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)

• Page Speed Insights 

• GTMetrix 

• Additional plugins may be required.

• Cookies Yes or other Cookie tracking platforms 

• Accessibility plugins like Accessibe



Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience

• 3+ years of professional experience with the Gutenberg / WordPress Block Editor

• Strong experience building websites with native Gutenberg blocks

• Ability to build complete WordPress websites independently

• Experience creating custom Gutenberg blocks and block patterns

• Understanding of responsive web design and ability to determine appropriate responsive behavior when every breakpoint is not provided

• Experience integrating WordPress with third-party APIs and platforms

• Ability to troubleshoot WordPress issues independently

• Strong understanding of website performance and optimization

• Ability to work with staging and production environments

• Strong attention to detail and quality assurance

• Strong written and spoken English

• Ability to communicate clearly about project status, questions, estimates, and technical issues

• Reliable availability during agreed-upon U.S. Pacific Time working hours



Additional Technical Skills

Experience with the following is preferred:

• HTML5

• CSS3

• JavaScript

• PHP

• React

• WordPress REST API

• Git / GitHub

• Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)

• Custom Post Types

• Full Site Editing (FSE)

• theme.json

• WordPress block themes

• WooCommerce

• WP-CLI

• MySQL

• Site migrations



Hosting & Deployment

You should be comfortable working with WordPress hosting environments, particularly:

• Bluehost

• WP Engine

• Staging environments

• Website backups and restoration

• SSL

• Production deployments

Experience performing WordPress site migrations is a plus.



Marketing & Analytics Awareness

You will not be responsible for managing our clients’ analytics or advertising platforms. However, you should understand that agency websites frequently contain marketing and conversion tracking that must be preserved during development.

Familiarity with the following is helpful:

• Google Tag Manager

• Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

• Google Ads conversion tracking

• Meta Pixel

• CallTrackingMetrics and/or CallRail

• Cookie consent platforms

• Google Consent Mode

• SEO fundamentals

• Schema markup

• Core Web Vitals

Developers must be careful not to remove, duplicate, or break existing analytics, advertising, SEO, or conversion-tracking functionality when modifying client websites.



Development Standards

We expect professional development practices on every project.

This includes:

• Clean, maintainable development

• Using native WordPress functionality whenever practical

• Avoiding unnecessary plugins

• No pirated, nulled, or unauthorized themes or plugins

• Cross-browser testing

• Desktop, tablet, and mobile QA

• Page-speed and performance optimization

• Development and testing in staging before production deployment

• Creating backups before significant website changes

• Documentation of custom development

• Testing changes before considering a task complete



Design & UI/UX

While our team will generally provide design elements, we are looking for a developer with a good visual eye and understanding of UI/UX.

You should be able to recognize spacing, typography, hierarchy, alignment, responsive behavior, and usability issues rather than simply building exactly what is shown without considering how the page functions across different screen sizes.



How We Work

You will work directly with our agency partners and internal team rather than our clients.

We currently use:

• Asana

• Wrike

• Discord

You should be comfortable receiving assignments, reviewing designs and requirements, asking questions when necessary, estimating the development time required, and then independently completing the work.

Clear communication is extremely important.



AI-Assisted Development

We are comfortable with our team using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI development tools to improve productivity.

However, you are responsible for all code you deploy.

You must understand, review, test, secure, and be able to troubleshoot any AI-assisted code before it is implemented on a client website.



How to Apply

• Please provide the following:

• A brief introduction describing your WordPress and Gutenberg development experience.

• 3–5 live WordPress websites you personally worked on that use Gutenberg.

• Examples of custom Gutenberg blocks you have developed.

• For each example, briefly explain your specific role and what you personally developed.

• GitHub profile or code samples, if available.

• Your current availability and approximate number of hours available per week.

• Your time zone and the hours you can consistently work during U.S. Pacific Time.

• Your current internet speed and a brief description of your workstation/setup.

• Confirm that you are comfortable with the posted $8.00 USD/hour contract rate.



Important

We are specifically looking for a WordPress Gutenberg developer, not simply someone familiar with WordPress page builders. 



This means you MUST have a portfolio with Generate Press, Generate Blocks on a generate press child theme. 

Please do not apply if the majority of your WordPress development experience is based on Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, or similar visual page builders. We do have clients that onboard with Wix, Squarespace, Webflow or Elementor but we typically request they move to GeneratePress.



We are looking for someone dependable who can become a trusted development resource for ongoing project-based work. Strong performance can lead to additional projects and increased hours.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Long Form + Shorts) for a Lighting Brand
description:
YouTube Video Editor: Long-Form + Shorts | Haven Lighting | Remote, Ongoing
