We're growing our YouTube channel, hosted by our founder, Chris. We need one reliable editor who can make every video look as good as our products.



What you'll edit each week



1 long video (6–12 minutes): real service calls from our weekly "Lights Out Tuesday" series, how-to design and install guides, and the business of running a lighting company.



5 vertical Shorts (20–60 seconds) for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and
, mostly cut from the same footage.



1 thumbnail per long video, made from our own footage.



A caption file (.srt) and a plain-text transcript with every final video.



What you'll get from us



Raw 4K phone footage from our Tuesday field day in a shared folder by Wednesday morning, plus a short brief: the hook, key points, chapters and the best Shorts moments with timestamps.



A fixed open and close that stays the same in every service-call video (we'll show you exactly how).



Clear feedback: one combined list of notes within 24 hours, with up to two revision rounds per video.



Steady, long-term work.



Weekly timing



Long video first draft: Friday.



Shorts first drafts: the following Monday.



Finals: within 48 hours of our notes.



You're a fit if you



Have edited how-to, trades, home-improvement or talking-head-plus-B-roll videos for real YouTube channels (not only a demo reel).



Know retention editing: a strong first 5 seconds, no dead air, clean readable captions, good pacing, without meme sounds, zoom spam or cheap effects. Our look is premium and clean.

Shared-folder access only. You'll never need our YouTube or social logins.



Music only from libraries we license; fonts and stock properly licensed.

Start with the words "Pro Tips", so we know you read this post.



3 links to YouTube videos you edited, including at least one Short, and what you did on each.



Your monthly rate for the scope above.



Your time zone and working hours.

Applications without live YouTube links won't be reviewed.

We're a recruitment partner hiring for an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events.  Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

title: Virtual Operations and Growth Assistant
description:

**Company:** Florida Pure Water Services (FLPWS)  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours per week  

**Industry:** Water Filtration, Home Services, Lead Generation



## About Florida Pure Water Services



Florida Pure Water Services provides residential and commercial water filtration, water softeners, reverse osmosis systems, and water treatment services throughout Central Florida.



We are growing our business and looking for a dependable, organized, proactive Virtual Operations & Growth Assistant who can help us find new business opportunities, recruit people, coordinate events, and keep daily operations organized.



This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys making phone calls, researching opportunities, communicating with people, and getting things done without constant supervision.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Event Research & Coordination

- Contact event organizers by phone and
 to ask about vendor spaces, booth fees, availability, and application requirements.

### 5. Administrative & Operations Support

s, make calls, and follow up on outstanding tasks.

## Required Qualifications



- Strong spoken and written English.

- Comfortable making phone calls to people in the United States.

- Professional, friendly, and confident phone communication.

- Organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.

- Able to research information online and maintain accurate spreadsheets.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Docs,
, and online calendars.

- Willing to learn GoHighLevel and other business software.

- Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet place to work.

- Able to work independently, follow instructions, and take initiative.

- Available to work a full-time schedule with sufficient overlap with Florida business hours.



## What We Are Looking For



We need someone who takes ownership of their work. We do not want someone who simply waits for instructions all day.



The ideal candidate will:

- Make calls confidently and professionally.

- Find opportunities instead of waiting for them to be provided.

- Follow up consistently with event organizers, applicants, and potential partners.

Previous experience in virtual assistance, recruiting, appointment setting, business development, event coordination, or lead generation is a plus.



## How Performance Will Be Measured



Performance will be evaluated based on:

- Realtors and potential referral partners contacted.

- Partnership meetings and follow-up opportunities generated.

- Accuracy of CRM records and spreadsheets.

## How to Apply



Please submit your application along with a **3–5 minute voice recording** demonstrating your spoken English and professional phone communication.



In the recording, briefly pretend you are calling a realtor to introduce Florida Pure Water Services, then calling an event coordinator to ask about booking a booth at a local festival.

title: Influencer Marketing Execution VA
description:
Eliot Management LLC



Remote | Full-Time | Must be available 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST



About Eliot Management LLC

Eliot Management LLC is an influencer marketing and talent management company that helps brands build meaningful relationships with creators and execute high-impact influencer campaigns. We work across influencer sourcing, paid creator campaigns, talent management, brand partnerships, events, and campaign execution. Our team works closely with brands and creators to manage partnerships from initial outreach through final deliverables and reporting. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Influencer Campaign Execution Virtual Assistant to support our growing team.



About the Role

This role is focused on the execution and coordination side of paid influencer campaigns. Once creators have been sourced and deals are confirmed, you will help ensure every campaign detail is properly communicated, tracked, and completed on time. You will manage campaign trackers, deliverables, timelines, creator communications, client feedback, posting schedules, and campaign reporting. You will serve as a key point of coordination between brands, creators, talent managers, and the internal team. This is not a traditional administrative VA position. We are looking for someone who is extremely organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces at once.



Key Responsibilities



Campaign Management

- Support the execution of paid influencer campaigns from confirmed deal through completion.

- Maintain accurate campaign trackers and status updates.

- Track creator participation, campaign requirements, deadlines, posting dates, and deliverables.

- Ensure all campaign details are accurately documented and communicated.

- Monitor campaign progress and proactively identify potential delays or issues.

- Follow up with creators, talent managers, and internal team members to keep campaigns moving.

- Ensure creators and managers understand campaign requirements, expectations, and deadlines.



Client & Creator Communication

- Act as a communication bridge between client brands and creators/talent managers.

- Relay client communications directly to talent managers and creators, ensuring campaign updates, feedback, revisions, and requirements are communicated clearly and in a timely manner.

- Translate client feedback into clear, actionable next steps for creators and managers.

- Follow up with talent managers and creators to confirm receipt and understanding of campaign updates.

- Communicate creator questions, concerns, and feedback back to the internal team and client when appropriate.

- Ensure changes to campaign direction, deliverables, timelines, or requirements are reflected accurately across all relevant parties.

- Maintain clear records of important campaign communications and decisions.

- Proactively flag miscommunication, conflicting information, or potential campaign issues before they escalate.



Deliverables & Content Tracking

- Track creator deliverables from initial brief through final submission.

- Monitor content deadlines and posting dates.

- Review submissions for completeness against campaign requirements.

- Flag missing, late, incorrect, or incomplete deliverables.

- Follow up with creators and managers when revisions or additional materials are required.

- Maintain organized records of live posts, links, screenshots, and campaign assets.

- Confirm campaign requirements have been fully completed before closing out a creator.

- Ensure final deliverables align with the approved campaign scope and client requirements.



Campaign Reporting & Recaps

- Collect campaign performance information and creator deliverables.

- Track views, engagement, impressions, reach, and other relevant campaign metrics.

- Organize creator content and performance data.

- Assist with campaign recaps and client-facing reports.

- Identify missing metrics or reporting information and follow up as needed.

- Maintain clean and accurate campaign records.



Administrative & Team Support

- Manage campaign-related
 communications and follow-ups.

- Assist with calendars, meetings, and campaign deadlines.

- Maintain Airtable, Google Sheets, and other internal systems.

- Support talent management and brand partnership tasks as needed.

- Handle confidential creator, client, and campaign information with discretion.

- Take on ad-hoc operational tasks and proactively identify workflow improvements.



What We're Looking For



Required

- 2+ years of experience in influencer marketing, talent management, social media marketing, project coordination, or a similar role.

- Hands-on experience supporting paid influencer campaigns.

- Experience managing campaign timelines, deliverables, or creator relationships.

- Experience communicating with influencers, talent managers, or agencies.

- Strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok creator ecosystems.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent organization and follow-through.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

- Ability to work 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST.



Strongly Preferred

- Experience managing influencer campaign deliverables.

- Experience working with talent managers or influencer agencies.

- Experience communicating client feedback to creators or managers.

- Experience with campaign reporting and performance metrics.

- Experience with Airtable, Google Sheets, Asana, Trello, or similar project-management tools.

- Experience working on U.S. influencer marketing campaigns.

- Experience managing multiple creators simultaneously.



The Ideal Candidate



You are someone who:

- Is extremely organized and naturally keeps track of details.

- Notices what is missing before someone has to ask.

- Doesn't let deadlines or follow-ups fall through the cracks.

- Can manage multiple creators and campaigns simultaneously.

- Is comfortable following up repeatedly and professionally.

- Can communicate client feedback clearly without losing important details.

- Can take a campaign task and see it through to completion.

- Keeps trackers, communications, and campaign information organized.

- Is proactive about identifying potential problems before they become issues.

- Moves quickly while maintaining accuracy.

- Is comfortable working with deadlines, deliverables, client feedback, and campaign details.

- Doesn't need to be micromanaged.



This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to build a long-term career in influencer marketing, talent management, campaign operations, or creator partnerships.

title: Amazon Fba product sourcer (Online arbitrage, Wholesale arbitrage)
description:
Looking for an experienced Amazon FBA sourcer to find profitable online 

arbitrage leads for our store. Must already be comfortable with SellerAmp 

and Keepa — this is not an entry-level/training role.



Hours: 25 hours/week required

Pay: Flat weekly rate (based on experience — mention your rate expectations 

when applying)

Quota: Minimum 5-10 vetted leads per day, logged in our shared Google Sheet

Reporting: Google Sheet must be updated daily — no batching leads to dump 

at the end of the week

Performance: Repeated missed quotas or unreported days will result in a 

warning, then pay adjustment, then termination if it continues



What you'll do:

- Reverse source: go through other sellers' storefronts on Amazon to find 

 what they're selling, then locate that same product cheaper from the 

 retailer/website they likely sourced it from

- Vet every lead using Keepa (price history, sales rank history, seller 

 count over time) and SellerAmp (ROI, fees, profitability, eligibility)

- Check BSR (Best Seller Rank) against category requirements to confirm 

 it's a fast enough mover before submitting a lead

- Confirm eligibility/ungating status on each ASIN before adding it to 

 the list — don't submit gated items unless already approved

- Flag any IP complaint risk, hazmat, or restricted brand issues

- Update the shared Google Sheet daily with: product name, buy link, cost, 

 sell price, ROI %, BSR, and eligibility status for every lead found

- OFFER COUNT MUST BE LOW



What you need to already know:

-We are gated on lots of products due to us being a new seller

- SellerAmp (SAS) — pulling ROI/profitability and running eligibility checks

- Keepa — reading price/rank history charts, spotting stable vs. volatile 

 listings

- Reverse sourcing / storefront stalking methodology

- What BSR ranges are actually sourceable per category (not just "low 

 number = good")

- Amazon's restricted categories, gated brands, and common IP-risk red 

 flags



Access provided:

- Your own restricted Seller Central login (Inventory access only — no 

 orders, payments, or financial data)

- Shared SellerAmp login for research

- Shared Google Sheet for daily lead logging

- You will connect YOUR OWN Seller Central login inside SellerAmp when 

 prompted — do not use any other login



To apply: send 2-3 sample leads with your reasoning (Keepa chart read, 

ROI calc, why you picked it). Shortlisted applicants will hop on a call 

to be interviewed before final hire.

title: Senior Xero Accounts Manager | Construction & Engineering (Remote)
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines



Hours: 40 hours per week, full time



Salary: Starting at USD $10 per hour, negotiable based on experience



Job overview



We're looking for an exceptional Senior Xero Accounts Manager to take full ownership of the accounts, payroll, financial administration and management reporting for our Australian engineering and construction business.



This is not a basic bookkeeping or data entry position.



We need someone highly experienced, sharp, organised and proactive who understands the numbers, identifies problems early and helps management make better financial decisions.



Our business manages multiple construction and engineering projects simultaneously, with significant costs across labour, materials, subcontractors and suppliers.



You will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing cash flow, processing Australian payroll, tracking work in progress (WIP) and providing clear visibility over project profitability.



We're looking for someone who can take responsibility for the accounts without needing constant supervision.



Key responsibilities



1. Xero and general accounting



Take ownership of our Xero accounts and maintain accurate financial records.



Complete bank and credit card reconciliations.



Manage accounts payable and receivable.



Prepare customer invoices and manage progress and milestone billing.



Follow up overdue invoices and actively manage collections.



Check supplier invoices against purchase orders and agreed pricing.



Monitor supplier balances, payment terms and upcoming obligations.



Identify duplicate charges, incorrect invoices and unexplained transactions.



Manage month end reconciliations and reporting.



Prepare GST and BAS information for review and lodgement by our accountant or registered BAS agent.



2. Australian payroll



Manage weekly or fortnightly payroll through Xero.



Process timesheets, employee wages and salary payments.



Understand Australian PAYG withholding, superannuation and Single Touch Payroll (STP).



Manage employee leave balances, annual leave and personal leave.



Check overtime, allowances and applicable employee entitlements.



Reconcile payroll costs and ensure they are allocated correctly to projects.



Review Hubstaff timesheets and identify discrepancies.



Maintain accurate payroll records and employee information.



Work with our external accountant or payroll specialist where required.



Previous experience managing Australian payroll is essential.



3. Work in progress (WIP) and project costing



This is a particularly important part of the role.



We operate a project based business where jobs can run for several weeks or months, with customer payments linked to project milestones.



You must understand how to track work in progress and accurately report project financial performance.



Responsibilities include:



Prepare and maintain monthly WIP reports across all active projects.



Track actual project expenditure against approved budgets.



Monitor labour, materials, subcontractors and other project costs.



Review project completion percentages, costs incurred and estimated costs to complete.



Reconcile project costs, progress claims and customer invoicing.



Identify unbilled work, accrued costs and outstanding project commitments.



Help ensure revenue and costs are recognised in the correct reporting periods under the accounting policies set by our accountant.



Identify jobs running over budget and flag potential margin losses early.



Prepare final job costing reports showing actual gross profit against estimated profit.



Investigate discrepancies and explain why projects performed above or below budget.



You should be comfortable working with project managers and operations staff to obtain accurate financial information.



4. Cash flow and financial reporting



Prepare and maintain rolling cash flow forecasts.



Track expected customer payments and upcoming supplier obligations.



Identify potential cash shortages before they occur.

Help management develop more reliable financial dashboards.



Take initiative when you identify something that could be done better.



Who we're looking for



You must have:



At least 5 years of relevant accounting or senior bookkeeping experience.



Advanced Xero experience.



Demonstrated experience processing Australian payroll.



Strong understanding of Australian GST, PAYG, superannuation and payroll requirements.



Experience preparing and reconciling WIP reports.



Strong construction or project costing experience.



Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Experience managing cash flow forecasting and financial reporting.



Strong understanding of profit and loss statements and balance sheets.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Exceptional attention to detail.



Confidence to question incorrect information and investigate discrepancies.



The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and take ownership of problems.



Experience working for an Australian construction, engineering or project based business will be highly regarded.



Formal accounting qualifications such as CPA, CA or equivalent will also be highly regarded.



What will make you successful



We want someone who takes ownership rather than waits for instructions.



If a supplier invoice looks wrong, you investigate it.



If a customer hasn't paid, you follow it up.



If a project is running over budget, you flag it.

Working arrangements

How to apply

title: Media Buyer

About JBI

JBI Advertising is a performance marketing agency obsessed with results. Growth doesn't stop once you're hired. Whether it's learning from the team around you, joining training sessions, taking on new challenges or developing your leadership skills, we'll support you in growing personally and professionally.

title: Business Law Attorney / Paralegal
description:
About Ensign Partners



Ensign Partners brings simplicity to complexity by integrating legal, financial, tax, insurance, and advisory expertise under one roof. Our clients receive one coordinated plan, one trusted team, and a clear path forward.



We are a values-driven firm built on professionalism, trust, and long-term relationships. Every role at Ensign matters. We believe exceptional client experiences are created through consistency, accuracy, and people who take pride in doing things the right way.



Position Overview



Ensign Partners is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Business Law Attorney / Paralegal to support our growing business law practice.



We are especially interested in candidates who are licensed attorneys in the Philippines or have significant experience supporting U.S. business law attorneys.



This role will focus on preparing and reviewing business legal documents, drafting contracts and agreements, assisting with business formations and transactions, managing legal workflows, and ensuring matters progress accurately and efficiently from start to finish.



You will work closely with our U.S.-based attorneys and legal team to prepare high-quality legal documents, conduct legal research, maintain organized client files, and support a wide range of business legal matters.



This position is ideal for someone with a strong legal background who enjoys drafting and reviewing contracts, understands business structures and transactions, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a professional, detail-oriented environment.



Key Responsibilities



· Draft, prepare, and revise business legal documents using attorney instructions, approved templates, and established procedures.



· Assist with business entity formation, including LLCs, corporations, partnerships, and related organizational documents.



· Prepare and review business agreements, including:



o Operating Agreements



o Shareholder and Partnership Agreements



o Buy-Sell Agreements



o Independent Contractor Agreements



o Employment Agreements



o Non-Disclosure and Confidentiality Agreements



o Service and Vendor Agreements



o Commercial Contracts



o Asset Purchase and Business Sale Agreements



o Corporate Resolutions and Governance Documents



· Support mergers, acquisitions, and other business transactions through document preparation, due diligence, and coordination.



· Assist with corporate maintenance, annual filings, ownership changes, and entity compliance documentation.



· Conduct legal research related to U.S. business law under attorney direction.



· Review documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting, consistency, and potential issues requiring attorney attention.



· Prepare documents for attorney review and incorporate revisions as directed.



· Track outstanding tasks, deadlines, and legal matters to ensure efficient workflow.



· Maintain organized electronic client files and legal document management systems.



· Follow established systems, templates, checklists, and workflows consistently.



· Maintain the highest level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.



· Support additional business law and administrative projects as assigned.



Required Qualifications



· Legal education, paralegal training, or professional experience in business law, corporate law, commercial contracts, or related legal work.



· Experience drafting, reviewing, or preparing legal documents and business agreements.



· Strong understanding of contracts, business entities, and general corporate legal principles.



· Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and document preparation skills.



· Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



· Strong legal research, proofreading, and analytical abilities.



· Ability to manage multiple legal matters simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.



· Ability to work independently while following attorney instructions and established procedures.



· Professional demeanor with a strong commitment to quality, confidentiality, and meeting deadlines.



· Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook.



Preferred Qualifications



· Licensed attorney in the Philippines — a significant advantage.



· Prior experience working with U.S.-based attorneys, law firms, or business clients.



· Experience with U.S. business law, corporate transactions, and contract drafting.



· Experience preparing LLC Operating Agreements, Buy-Sell Agreements, and other corporate governance documents.



· Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence and transaction documentation.



· Experience with business entity formation and corporate compliance.



· Familiarity with U.S. legal terminology, document formatting, and legal procedures.



· Experience with Clio or other legal practice management software.



· Experience with legal document management systems and electronic signature platforms.



· Strong ability to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and potential legal issues for attorney review.



· Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and improve legal workflows.



Why Join Ensign Partners?



Ensign Partners is intentional about building a workplace where people are trusted, supported, and held to high standards. This role is an important part of helping business owners protect, operate, and grow their businesses with confidence.



Joining Ensign means:



· Being part of a mission-driven, people-first firm.



· Working in a professional, organized, and collaborative environment.



· Having clear expectations and the opportunity to take ownership of your work.



· Working alongside experienced U.S. attorneys and legal professionals.



· Gaining exposure to a variety of business law matters, contracts, and transactions.



· Contributing meaningfully to a growing and respected organization.



· Building a long-term career with opportunities for professional growth.



If you have a strong legal background, enjoy working with business contracts and corporate legal matters, and are committed to producing exceptional legal work with accuracy and professionalism, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Ensign Partners team.



Philippine licensed attorneys with strong English communication skills and an interest in U.S. business law are strongly encouraged to apply.

 us directly.

 us outside of this job post, you will be automatically disqualified.

Business Law Attorney / Paralegal at Ensign Partners

· Your legal education and whether you are a licensed attorney in the Philippines.



· Your years of experience in business law, corporate law, or contract preparation.



· Whether you have experience working with U.S. attorneys or U.S. law firms.

· Your English proficiency level.



· Your expected monthly salary in USD.



PAY WILL DEPEND ON LEVEL OF EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS.

title: Linux / Cloud Engineer (Work from home)

You would be interfacing with our clients over Zoom Video calls providing remote guided assistance to ensure their self-hosted environment meets certain specifications and perform software installation and/or version upgrades within the client’s cloud environment.



This role requires that you are customer-facing, so you will need to be;

- be very confident in front of customers

- be very professional and present concepts well to customers

- be a great troubleshooter

- be an expert in Linux

- good familiarity with Kubernetes and KOTS (Kubernetes Off-The-Shelf)



The key is that you have great troubleshooting skills as sometimes the deployments require some level of creativity.



Our job is to ensure that the client’s software is installed/upgraded and to pave a path to remove the roadblocks for a successful deployment. In this role, you must be extremely comfortable installing and configuring common Linux distributions (eg Ubuntu RedHat etc).



Secondary Role:

Your Secondary Role would be help manage and automate our private cloud hosting environment to drive operational efficiency. We develop and manage our own SaaS AI application as well as integrate AI with 3rd party applications which are hosted in our environment.



This would include:

• Deploying/provisioning servers

• Testing applications and performance

• Automating cloud processes



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Windows and Linux (ideally Ubuntu) server deployment/administration

• Docker and Kubernetes / KOTS

• Gitlab

• Automation (Microsoft Windows automation, SALT, Terraform, PXE Booting, Ubuntu Autoinstaller, Cloud-Init etc)

• Networking skills (IP addressing, subnetting, firewalls, routing/switching, DNS, etc)

• Cloud infrastructure (virtualization - Proxmox/VMware – deploying/managing cloud environments)

• Python/Scripting

• Data Analytics/SQL



ABOUT US:

We are a small technology solutions company in the USA offering private cloud hosting, enterprise software readiness and deployment, managed IT services, AI integrations, and SaaS services.



WE INVEST IN YOU:

We hire with the intent that you would become part of our team for the long-term. We are a very small company with a fairly fast-paced environment and can offer incredible opportunity for career growth in tech and access to learn about the newest technologies, private cloud and AI.



OUR AUDIENCE:

Our audience is Americans….. So you would need to have EXCELLENT spoken English skills (without a discernable accent), plus very good written/grammar skills.



WORK SCHEDULE:

The work week schedule would be something like:

Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 5:00pm Central Standard Time USA.

Some weekend work may be requested at times.

** Please do not apply if you are not available during this work window. **



INTERVIEW:

An online phone interview will be required via Zoom.



To be considered, please forward:

• Your resume (PDF format or link to Google drive preferred)

• A paragraph or so about yourself that discusses your level of experience in each of the technical required areas.

• Your level of spoken English (please send an audio file link/video link of your English speaking skills if you have one)

• Your desired compensation – this is very important. Resumes will not be considered without it.



COMPENSATION:

You would be paid on an hourly basis. We would expect 40 hours per week worked. Compensation will be d
 on your overall experience and value.

title: Customer Success & Social Media Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian BPO company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our team members can build stable and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will be supporting the owners of a growing promotional products and branded merchandise business based in Canada. In just three years, the business has built a large client list of companies that rely on them for promotional items and corporate gifts.

A marketing agency already runs their paid ads and campaigns. What the owners need now is someone in their corner who owns the client relationships, records, and social media content that keep the business growing — so they can focus on their largest accounts and new business.



Job Overview

We are looking for a full-time, remote Customer Success & Social Media Assistant who will become the owners’ right hand across three areas of the business: client follow-up, social media content, and administration.

This is not a traditional admin role, and it is not a cold-calling sales role. It is a client success role at heart. Today, the biggest accounts get the owners’ personal attention while smaller clients don’t get the follow-up they deserve. Your job is to make sure every client gets consistent, proactive attention.



Your mission is simple: within 90 days, every client in the database — not just the biggest accounts — should have an up-to-date record (what they ordered, what they paid, what was last discussed) and a regular touchpoint scheduled, and the business should be posting on social media consistently.



The right candidate is a multitasker with high agency who doesn’t wait to be told what to do. You will likely come in strong in one or two of these areas; the owners will coach you on the rest. As the business grows, so does your role.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday, full-time (40 hours per week)

• 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Toronto time)



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 40,000 – 45,000 per month

Quarterly Bonuses Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Client Follow-Up & Account Management

• Proactive touchpoints — Own regular check-ins with the business’s small and mid-sized clients: reorder reminders, new product ideas, and seasonal outreach (e.g., Q4 corporate gifting and year-end orders)

• Follow-through — Follow up on quotes, open inquiries, and past orders so no client goes quiet simply because no one reached out

• Prioritized follow-up lists — Use order history and past spend to d
 who to contact and when

• Client communication — Respond to client
s and calls professionally using a company
 and a local Canadian phone line

• Opportunity spotting — Flag reorder and upsell opportunities and hand off larger deals to the owners

Note: this is warm follow-up with existing clients and inquiries, not cold calling.

Social Media & Content

• Create and schedule regular posts for the business’s social media accounts — graphics, captions, product spotlights, and finished client projects

• Build and maintain a simple monthly content calendar

• Coordinate with the external agency that manages paid ads so organic content and paid campaigns stay aligned

• Monitor comments and direct messages and route new inquiries to the right place



Admin & Client Records

• Organize and maintain the client database: contact details, pricing quoted, order history, and past conversations

• Archive quotes, orders, and correspondence so “what did we charge them last time?” can be answered in seconds

• Support order administration — track order status, confirm details, and keep clients updated on timelines

• Help manage the owners’ inbox and calendar as needed

• Prepare simple weekly updates on client follow-ups, outcomes, and content posted



Qualifications

Required:

• At least 3 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as customer success, account management, client services, or inside sales

• Experience managing a list or portfolio of existing clients, including follow-up and relationship building

• Hands-on experience creating social media content for a business or brand (Canva or similar, captions, scheduling)

• Strong English communication skills (verbal and written) — you will
 and speak with Canadian clients directly

• Highly organized with strong record-keeping habits; comfortable with a CRM, Google Sheets, or Excel

• Experience working night shift for US or Canadian companies

• Proactive and self-directed — comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a remote setup

Nice to Have:

• Experience in promotional products, print, merchandise, or other B2B product sales

• Experience with HubSpot or another CRM

• Experience with Meta Business Suite or social media scheduling tools

• Experience working alongside a marketing agency

• Basic graphic design or photo editing skills

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) and willingness to use them in daily workflows



Who Thrives in This Role:

• You enjoy being the person clients know and trust — you remember what they ordered last time and why

• You’re a natural multitasker who can move from a client
 to a social post to a spreadsheet without losing track

• You have high agency — when you notice a client hasn’t ordered in months, you reach out before anyone asks

• You get genuine satisfaction from organizing messy information into a clean, reliable system



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

Career Growth:

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You'll be supporting the two founders of a well-established Canadian staffing and consulting firm based in Toronto. They run a highly systemised, fast-moving business, and they're the kind of leaders people want to work for: patient teachers with high standards, who invest in training, tooling, and growth for their team. They automate anything that can be automated, document their processes, and give their people the systems and support to do great work. This is a company that has kept the same right-hand EA for years at a time because they know how to set the right person up to win.



Job Overview

We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant to become the operational right hand to both founders. This is a blended role: you'll run two demanding executive calendars and inboxes and own a broad, varied administrative workload that keeps the business moving behind the scenes.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to be handed a narrow checklist and told exactly what to do all day. It's for a confident, self-managing operator who thrives on variety, builds their own systems, and stays calm when they're switching between very different tasks. The founders manage their own time down to the 15-minute block, use tools like ClickUp and Calendly, and will meet with you regularly, drip responsibilities to you as you master them, and give you SOPs to follow. The learning curve is real, and the people who succeed here lean into it rather than get overwhelmed by it.

This role starts as an executor and is built to grow. As you learn how each founder thinks, you'll take on more ownership and judgment over time.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (Toronto) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT (night shift)

Please only apply if you're able to reliably work night shift long-term.



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 42,000 – 46,000 per month

Quarterly Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Executive Support (Two Founders)

• Calendar orchestration — Manage two busy, highly structured executive calendars, protect focus time, and keep both founders' days running smoothly — coordinating across their schedules without dropping a beat.

• Inbox management — Triage and organise both inboxes, draft replies for review, and gradually take over sending on their behalf as you learn their voice and judgment.

• Meeting prep — Prepare briefing materials and agendas, and make sure both founders walk into every meeting ready.

• Proactive time management — Run their calendars proactively the way they run their own — booked, protected, colour-coded, and always a step ahead.



Administrative & Operations Support

• Documents & agreements — Prepare and execute client agreements, build and customise proposals, and produce clean, professional documents, reports, and presentations.

• Systems & filing — Own and organise a large Google Drive database so records are structured and easy to find.

• Process execution — Follow documented SOPs to the letter and build your own systems where none exist — you'll be trusted to create order, not wait for it.

• RFP & portal management — Manage the process around RFP solicitations and government portals (managing the workflow, not answering them), keeping deadlines and submissions on track.

• General admin — Own the wide range of recurring and one-off admin that comes across the founders' desks so they can stay focused on high-value work.

Sales & Business Development Support

• Lead follow-up & CRM — Support business development with lead follow-up, prospect tracking, and keeping the CRM clean and up to date.

• Scheduling — Book and coordinate business development and prospect meetings.



Qualifications

Required

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant supporting a founder, CEO, or senior executive — ideally supporting more than one executive at a time

• Proven ability to manage demanding executive calendars and inboxes with discretion, structure, and good judgment

• Strong written and verbal English — you'll draft emails, documents, and correspondence on behalf of the founders daily

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

• Experience with broad, varied admin — documents, proposals, filing, process management — not just calendar and inbox

• Highly organised and self-disciplined — you keep everything in one system, not scattered across sticky notes, notebooks, and half-used lists

• A confident, self-managing operator who can switch gears between very different tasks without getting overwhelmed

• Proactive mindset — you anticipate needs, spot problems early, and take initiative without waiting to be asked

• Comfortable working efficiently and being measured on output — you get the right work done in a reasonable amount of time

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

• Able to reliably work night shift (Toronto business hours) long-term



Nice to Have

• Experience supporting two or more executives at once

• Experience with ClickUp or another project management tool (Asana, Monday, Trello)

• Familiarity with CRM tools (logging contacts, deals, and activity)

• Experience with proposals, RFPs, or agreement/contract administration

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to work within an AI-first, automation-first workflow

• Background in staffing, recruiting, professional services, or consulting



Who Thrives in This Role

The founders have kept an EA in this role for years at a time when they've found the right person. Here's who that is:

• You lean into a learning curve instead of being intimidated by it — when something's new, your attitude is “I'll figure it out.”

• You thrive on variety and can switch between very different tasks in a single day without losing your footing

• You build your own systems and processes — you create order rather than wait to be handed it

• You're calm and low-drama under a full plate — you don't overthink or talk yourself out of things before you try them

• You're disciplined and organised — you manage your own time as tightly as the people you support manage theirs

• You work efficiently and take ownership — when something's in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarise, you don't ramble

• You're a fast learner who picks up new tools, systems, and preferences quickly, and genuinely enjoy working smarter with AI and automation



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

Career Growth

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | Demand Gen, Lead Generation & Multi-Account Growth
description:
We’re looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Google Ads specialist to manage multiple accounts with substantial advertising budgets and help generate more qualified leads and customers.



You should be confident owning both strategy and day-to-day execution. Strong Google Demand Gen experience is essential, alongside advanced Search campaign management, lead magnets, conversion tracking, landing-page optimisation, and customer acquisition strategy.



We need someone who can understand each business, identify opportunities, manage budgets carefully, and explain how their work contributes to commercial results.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Manage multiple accounts through Google Ads Manager Account (MCC), with clear priorities, disciplined budget pacing, and consistent oversight.

• Build, audit, optimise, and scale Search and Demand Gen campaigns.

• Develop account structures, bidding strategies, targeting, audience segmentation, exclusions, and budget allocation suited to each business.

• Create acquisition strategies around customer intent, compelling offers, and lead magnets, with a clear path from initial interest to qualified enquiry and customer.

• Research keywords, search terms, competitors, and customer needs. Write and test ad copy and provide clear creative briefs.

• Improve landing pages, forms, and conversion journeys through structured testing.

• Set up, audit, and troubleshoot measurement using Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and CRM or offline conversion data.

• Use qualified-lead, sales, and customer acquisition data to guide optimisation and budget decisions.

• Evaluate Performance Max and remarketing opportunities where appropriate.

• Report clearly on performance, explain what changed, and recommend the next actions.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Substantial hands-on Google Ads experience, including personally managing several accounts at the same time.

• A proven record of managing significant per-account budgets responsibly and improving business outcomes.

• Demonstrable Google Demand Gen experience, including audience strategy, creative testing, and assessment of lead quality or customer results.

• Experience using lead magnets, offers, and landing-page tests within a broader acquisition strategy.

• Strong knowledge of conversion tracking and how to connect advertising activity with CRM and sales outcomes.

• The ability to diagnose problems across campaigns, tracking, landing pages, and the sales funnel.

• Clear communication, reliable execution, and the confidence to explain recommendations and trade-offs.



Success in this role means increasing qualified leads and customer acquisition while maintaining control of spend and acquisition costs.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• Two or three brief case studies. For each, state the business type, advertising spend, currency, reporting period, results, and exactly what you personally managed. Anonymised examples are welcome.

• At least one Google Demand Gen example. Explain the strategy, what you tested, and the results or lessons.

• The number of accounts you have managed concurrently and the typical and largest budgets you have personally handled.

• A short summary of your GA4, Google Tag Manager, CRM, and offline conversion tracking experience.

• Your availability, earliest start date, and expected rate, including the currency and whether it is hourly or monthly.



Finally, in a few sentences: if an account generates more leads but sales are not improving, what would you investigate first, and why?



We are looking for clear evidence of hands-on expertise, sound judgment, and measurable results.

title: Social Media Manager & Content Creator — Local Event Venue
description:
**Social Media Manager & Content Creator — Local Event Venue**



409 Woodbury Event Space in Altadena, California, is looking for a creative, proactive social media professional to help grow our local presence and turn interest into event inquiries and bookings.



Our venue is a warm, inviting indoor and outdoor space for celebrations, gatherings, and meaningful occasions. We’re a small, heart-centered business, and we want our marketing to reflect that personal connection.



**What we need**



Someone who can take ownership of our social media marketing—from developing ideas and creating content to posting, engaging, and tracking results.



We have some event photos and videos, but we need someone who can keep the momentum going with limited material. You should be comfortable generating fresh ideas, repurposing existing content, and finding creative ways to showcase the venue without waiting for us to supply every photo, caption, or direction.



**Responsibilities**



- Develop a content plan and maintain consistent posting on Instagram and
.

- Create engaging reels, stories, graphics, and captions that match our website, brand, and personality.

- Develop content around event possibilities, venue features, planning tips, local connections, and reasons to gather.

- Build a relevant local following, especially within approximately 30 miles of Altadena, with additional reach across Los Angeles and Orange counties.

- Engage thoughtfully with potential clients, event planners, vendors, local businesses, and relevant pages.

- Identify appropriate
 groups, local event pages, directories, and other places to promote the venue while following each platform’s rules.

- Help turn engagement into tour requests, inquiries, and bookings.

- Track results and adjust the approach based on what brings meaningful interest.



**The right person**



- Has experience marketing a local business, ideally in events, hospitality, or a related field.

- Can understand and maintain our brand’s warm, neighborly voice.

- Is resourceful, creative, organized, and comfortable working independently.

- Understands how to reach people who could realistically use our venue.

- Brings ideas and follows through without needing daily instructions.

- Values genuine relationships and qualified inquiries over follower counts alone.



**To apply, please include:**



1. Examples of social media accounts you’ve managed and the results you helped achieve.

2. Three content ideas for an event venue with limited new photos or videos.

3. A brief explanation of how you would attract and engage a local audience around Altadena and Pasadena.





We’re looking for someone who sees the possibilities in our space and can help others see them, too.

title: Google Ads Specialist — Motivated Seller Lead Generation for Real Estate
description:
# Google Ads Specialist — Motivated Seller Lead Generation for Real Estate



**Company:** Northmark Home Buyers  

**Website:** 
  

**Location:** Remote  

**Hours and compensation:** Please include your availability and expected monthly compensation.



## About the business



Northmark Home Buyers buys residential properties directly from homeowners in Illinois. We pursue wholesale, novation, and fix-and-flip opportunities.



We’re building a consistent source of qualified seller leads through Google Search ads. Our target territory includes DuPage, Cook, Will, Kane, Kendall, Grundy, Lake, McHenry, Winnebago, Peoria, and Tazewell counties.



We have a website and plan to use GoHighLevel for lead management and follow-up. The owner understands real estate acquisitions and will handle seller conversations, property evaluation, and offers.



## The role



We’re looking for someone who can plan, launch, manage, and improve Google Ads campaigns that generate qualified homeowner inquiries.



Success means attracting homeowners with properties we can evaluate and potentially purchase. You should be comfortable measuring lead quality and acquisition outcomes alongside campaign metrics.



## Responsibilities



- Develop a Google Search advertising strategy for our target markets.

- Research keywords, seller intent, competition, and estimated advertising costs.

- Recommend how to allocate the budget across markets.

- Build campaigns, ad groups, ads, assets, and negative keyword lists.

- Review our website and recommend landing-page improvements.

- Set up and verify form and call conversion tracking.

- Connect campaign attribution with GoHighLevel.

- Develop a process for reporting qualified leads and later outcomes back to Google.

- Review search terms, geographic performance, spending, and lead quality.

- Provide a clear weekly report explaining results, changes, and next steps.

- Follow Google’s advertising policies, including applicable housing restrictions.



## What we’re looking for



- Hands-on experience independently managing Google Search campaigns.

- Strong experience with lead generation; motivated seller or cash home buyer experience is highly preferred.

- Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, GA4, call tracking, and conversion tracking.

- Experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM.

- Ability to distinguish a tracking problem, traffic problem, landing-page problem, and follow-up problem.

- Clear communication and practical recommendations supported by evidence.

- Honest reporting about results, uncertainty, and unsuccessful tests.



We are open to your recommendations on campaign structure and bidding. You should be able to explain your decisions and the conditions under which you would change them.



## Interview: Present your PPC plan for Northmark



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to present a proposed Google PPC plan for our business.



Prepare a concise presentation of approximately **5–8 slides**, followed by a **20–30 minute discussion**. Use our website and the business information in this posting. Clearly label assumptions and estimates.



Please cover:



1. **Market selection:** Which counties would you launch in first, and why? Would you separate Chicago-area, Rockford, and Peoria campaigns?

2. **Budget:** Recommend an initial monthly advertising budget and explain how you would allocate it. Separate ad spend, your compensation, and any additional software costs.

3. **Campaign structure:** Show your proposed campaigns and ad groups, sample keywords and match types, negative keyword examples, and two sample ads.

4. **Website and conversion path:** Identify the most important improvements you would make before sending paid traffic.

5. **Tracking:** Explain how you would track forms, calls, qualified sellers, appointments, and contracts using Google Ads and GoHighLevel.

6. **First 30–90 days:** Explain your launch sequence, optimization process, reporting, and criteria for expanding, reducing, or pausing spending.

7. **Forecast and risks:** Explain what you would need to estimate lead volume and cost. If you provide forecasts, show the assumptions and uncertainty.



**We will evaluate your reasoning, measurement approach, and understanding of seller lead quality.** We don’t expect guaranteed results or a fully built campaign as an interview assignment.



## How to apply



Start your application with **“Northmark PPC”** and include:



- A brief summary of your relevant Google Ads experience.

- Whether you have managed campaigns for cash home buyers or motivated seller leads.

- One or two examples of campaigns you personally managed, including your responsibilities, ad spend, time period, results, and how a conversion was defined. Redacted examples are welcome.

- Your experience with GoHighLevel, call tracking, and offline conversion tracking.

- Your availability, time zone, and expected monthly compensation.

- Your answer to this question: **If a campaign generates inexpensive leads but very few qualified seller conversations, how would you investigate?**



We’re looking for a long-term partner who can build a measurable, dependable source of acquisition opportunities.

title: WordPress to Webflow Developer
description:
Job Description: WordPress to Webflow Developer

Position: WordPress to Webflow Developer

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote



Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced WordPress and Webflow Developer to rebuild an existing

WordPress website in Webflow, while implementing requested design and functionality

modifications.



This role requires someone who is already highly proficient in both WordPress and Webflow

and can independently execute the project with minimal guidance. We are specifically looking

for an expert who can confidently assess the existing website, determine the best approach for

rebuilding it, and deliver a polished Webflow site.



Key Responsibilities

• Rebuild an existing WordPress website in Webflow.

• Analyze the current WordPress website and replicate its structure, content, and key

functionality in Webflow.

• Implement requested design, layout, and functionality modifications.

• Ensure the new Webflow site is responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

• Maintain website usability, performance, and visual consistency during the rebuild.

• Troubleshoot and resolve development or design issues independently.

• Translate existing website elements into Webflow using clean and scalable practices.

• Collaborate with the team to understand requested changes and provide technical

recommendations.

• Conduct thorough testing before launch.



Requirements

• Proven expert-level experience with Webflow.

• Strong experience developing and customizing WordPress websites.

• Demonstrated experience rebuilding or migrating websites from WordPress to Webflow.

• Strong understanding of responsive web design.

• Ability to accurately recreate existing websites while improving layouts and functionality

where requested.

• Strong knowledge of HTML and CSS; JavaScript knowledge is a plus.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of the project.

• Able to understand requirements and execute without needing extensive training or

hand-holding.



Non-Negotiable

We are looking for an expert who already knows how to do this—not someone who will need

to figure out Webflow or learn the process while working on the project.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Webflow CMS.

• Experience with website migrations and redirects/SEO preservation.

• Experience optimizing websites for speed and responsiveness.

• Portfolio demonstrating previous WordPress-to-Webflow projects.



Success Measures

• Existing WordPress website successfully rebuilt in Webflow.

• Requested modifications are implemented accurately.

• Website is fully responsive and functional across devices.

• Project is completed with minimal supervision and troubleshooting support.

• Final website meets the expected design, functionality, and quality standards.

1. Updated CV

2. Introduction Video

3. Active Whatsapp number

4. Earliest availability to start

This remote position offers opportunities for professional development and exposure to advanced U.S. international tax matters.

• Advise clients on U.S. international tax laws affecting cross-border transactions. 

• Research and evaluate complex U.S. international tax issues and prepare well-supported legal analyses. 

• Assist clients with Inbound U.S. Tax matters. 

• Assist clients with Outbound U.S. Tax matters.

Required Work Experience

•	Strong understanding of U.S. federal tax law and related international tax principles. 

•	Working knowledge of Inbound and Outbound U.S. tax concepts. 

•	Excellent legal research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 

•	Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills. 

•	Ability to interpret complex U.S. tax provisions and communicate practical solutions. 

•	Ability to manage multiple assignments independently while meeting deadlines. 

•	Strong attention to technical accuracy. 

 

Preferred Work Experience

 • 	Cross-border transactions. 

•	Tax treaty interpretation. 

•	Foreign tax credit planning. 

•	Transfer pricing fundamentals.

 • 	Foreign information reporting. 

•	U.S. tax compliance for multinational businesses.

Skills

title: Ecommerce Website Designer | Figma & Shopify | Long-Term Role
description:
Ecommerce Web Designer | Figma & Conversion Rate Optimization



**Chapie is a U.S. consumer brand that makes vacuum-insulated cases designed to protect lip balm, cosmetics, and everyday essentials from heat.** Our brand combines functional product innovation with colorful designs and collectible collections. Learn more at **
**.



Your primary focus will be designing product pages and landing pages that look excellent, explain our products clearly, and help turn visitors into customers.



**We’re planning to redesign most of our website, with plenty of hours available for the right person.** You’ll work directly with the founder and our developer as part of our team, with room to bring your own ideas and help shape the website.



This is a design role. **Our developer will build your designs in Shopify, so coding skills are not required.**



## What You'll Do



- Design complete ecommerce product pages and landing pages in Figma for mobile and desktop

- Research our products, customers, and competitors to understand selling points and purchase objections

- Structure pages with clear headlines, benefits, demonstrations, comparisons, reviews, FAQs, and calls to action

- Create graphics that explain product features, dimensions, compatibility, and use cases

- Improve product selection and make the purchasing process easier

- Recommend copy and messaging that communicate value and build customer confidence

- Deliver organized Figma files with reusable components, assets, and clear developer instructions

- Review completed pages with our developer to ensure they match your designs

- Suggest improvements and design variations for conversion testing



## Tools



You should be comfortable with:



- Figma, including Auto Layout, components, prototyping, and developer handoff

- Graphic design tools for creating and editing website assets

- Shopify storefront layouts and common ecommerce functionality



Experience using analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, or A/B testing tools is a plus.



## What We're Looking For



- Excellent visual taste and a strong portfolio of ecommerce product pages

- Advanced Figma skills

- Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and mobile shopping behavior

- Ability to turn technical product features into clear benefits and compelling visuals

- Strong typography, spacing, layout, and visual hierarchy

- Clear English communication and strong attention to detail

- Ability to explain the reasoning behind your design decisions

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Part-Time): Ads and Social
description:
About Us

We are a small Australian performance marketing consultancy running Google and Meta ads for brands in Australia, Europe and the US. Our founder worked at Google and Meta. We all work remotely.



The Role

A short-form video editor who thinks while editing. We give you the script, the footage and a written standard. You return tight, premium videos that need few revisions, and you tell us before you start if something in the brief does not add up. You do not write scripts or concepts.



The first month is a probation month on our own content: about 5 short videos a week, each with versions for each channel, plus a visual for each of our 4 monthly blog posts (a website and a LinkedIn version). Once that runs well, you also edit ad videos for our clients, starting with a European consumer-finance brand.



Hours and Pay

About 20 hours a week, overlapping Melbourne time. Probation month: US$600. From month two, as client work starts, your rate rises with the work, up to US$1,000 a month for about 20 hours a week. Monthly contract.



What Good Looks Like

* Vertical videos, 6 to 60 seconds (9:16, 1080 x 1920, 1:1 1080 x 1080). Script, hook and call to action used exactly as written.

* Tight, natural pacing with no dead air. In ads, a new shot every 1 to 1.5 seconds. Every image matches the line under it, premium footage only.

* Shorts and variants with different images and a different first 3 seconds.

* Every line on screen for sound off. Every figure matches the source exactly.

* Each brand’s written standard followed, checked by you before you send.

* On time, revisions within 24 hours, and early questions instead of late surprises.



Real, Not Generated

Our own brand: no AI images, voices or avatars. Client work: real footage always, with AI voice-over or versioning where the client uses it.



How We Hire

Paid test 1, US$25: a 30-second video from our footage and a one-page checklist. The best two or three then get paid test 2, US$75: a 15-second ad and an 8-second short from a script, stock footage and a brand standard.



How To Apply

Start your message with the word “margin”. Then answer:



1. Links to two or three vertical videos you edited, ideally ads, as public links (YouTube, Vimeo, or Google Drive set to “anyone with the link”). Which were for brands in Australia, Europe, the UK or the US?

2. Your monthly rate in US dollars for about 20 hours a week, and your hourly rate.

3. A video that needed more than two rounds of revisions: what caused it, and what do you do now to prevent it?

4. A mistake you caught before it went out: what happened?



Short and honest beats long and polished.
